import uuid

from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Set
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

# ============================================================================
# Domain Models
# ============================================================================

class GoalType(Enum):
    """Types of health and fitness goals."""
    WEIGHT_LOSS = "weight_loss"
    MUSCLE_GAIN = "muscle_gain"
    ENDURANCE = "endurance"
    FLEXIBILITY = "flexibility"
    GENERAL = "general"

    """Types of activities that can be logged."""
    RUNNING = "running"
    CYCLING = "cycling"
    SWIMMING = "swimming"
    WEIGHTLIFTING = "weightlifting"
    YOGA = "yoga"
    WALKING = "walking"
    OTHER = "other"

@dataclass
class Goal:
    """Represents a health/fitness goal."""
    goal_id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    title: str = ""
    description: str = ""
    goal_type: GoalType = GoalType.GENERAL
    target_value: float = 0.0
    current_value: float = 0.0
    deadline: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
    is_team_goal: bool = False
    created_by: str = ""  # user_id or team_id
    
    def progress_percentage(self) -> float:
        """Calculate progress percentage."""
        if self.target_value == 0:
            return 0.0
        return min(100.0, (self.current_value / self.target_value) * 100)
    
    def is_expired(self) -> bool:
        """Check if goal deadline has passed."""
        return datetime.now() > self.deadline

@dataclass
class Challenge:
    """Represents a health/fitness challenge."""
    challenge_id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    title: str = ""
    description: str = ""
    activity_type: ActivityType = ActivityType.OTHER
    start_date: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
    end_date: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now() + timedelta(days=7))
    target_metric: str = ""  # e.g., "total_distance", "total_calories"
    target_value: float = 0.0
    is_team_challenge: bool = False
    created_by: str = ""  # user_id or team_id
    participants: Set[str] = field(default_factory=set)  # user_ids
    
    def is_active(self) -> bool:
        """Check if challenge is currently active."""
        now = datetime.now()
        return self.start_date <= now <= self.end_date

@dataclass
class ActivityLog:
    """Represents a logged activity."""
    log_id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    user_id: str = ""
    activity_type: ActivityType = ActivityType.OTHER
    duration_minutes: float = 0.0
    distance_km: float = 0.0
    calories_burned: float = 0.0
    weight_kg: Optional[float] = None
    notes: str = ""
    timestamp: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)

@dataclass

    content: str = ""

        """Add user to a team."""
        self.teams.add(team_id)
    
    def remove_team(self, team_id: str) -> None:
        """Remove user from a team."""
        self.teams.discard(team_id)
    
    def add_personal_goal(self, goal: Goal) -> None:
        """Add a personal goal."""
        goal.is_team_goal = False
        goal.created_by = self.user_id
        self.personal_goals.append(goal)

        """Log an activity."""
        activity.user_id = self.user_id
        self.activity_logs.append(activity)

        """Add a member to the team."""
        if user_id not in self.members:
            self.members.add(user_id)
            return True
        return False
    
    def remove_member(self, user_id: str) -> bool:
        """Remove a member from the team."""
        if user_id in self.members:
            self.members.remove(user_id)
            return True
        return False

        """Add a team goal."""
        goal.is_team_goal = True
        goal.created_by = self.team_id
        self.team_goals.append(goal)

        """Add a team challenge."""
        challenge.is_team_challenge = True
        challenge.created_by = self.team_id
        self.team_challenges.append(challenge)
    
    def add_message(self, message: Message) -> None:
        """Add a message to team chat."""
        message.team_id = self.team_id
        self.messages.append(message)

# ============================================================================
# HealthTeamSync Application
# ============================================================================

class HealthTeamSync:
    """Main application class for HealthTeamSync."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        """Initialize the application with empty data stores."""
        self.users: Dict[str, User] = {}
        self.teams: Dict[str, Team] = {}
        self.challenges: Dict[str, Challenge] = {}
        
    # ========================================================================
    # User Management
    # ========================================================================
    
    def register_user(self, username: str, email: str) -> User:
        """Register a new user."""
        if any(u.email == email for u in self.users.values()):
            raise ValueError(f"Email {email} already registered")
        
        user = User(username=username, email=email)
        self.users[user.user_id] = user
        return user
    
    def get_user(self, user_id: str) -> Optional[User]:
        """Get user by ID."""
        return self.users.get(user_id)
    
    # ========================================================================
    # Team Management
    # ========================================================================
    
    def create_team(self, name: str, description: str, creator_id: str) -> Team:
        """Create a new team."""
        if not self.get_user(creator_id):
            raise ValueError(f"User {creator_id} not found")
        
        # Check for unique team name
        if any(t.name == name for t in self.teams.values()):
            raise ValueError(f"Team name '{name}' already exists")
        
        team = Team(name=name, description=description, created_by=creator_id)
        team.add_member(creator_id)
        
        # Add team to user's team list
        user = self.users[creator_id]
        user.add_team(team.team_id)
        
        self.teams[team.team_id] = team
        return team
    
    def join_team(self, user_id: str, team_id: str) -> bool:
        """Join an existing team."""
        user = self.get_user(user_id)
        team = self.teams.get(team_id)
        
        if not user:
            raise ValueError(f"User {user_id} not found")
        if not team:
            raise ValueError(f"Team {team_id} not found")
        
        if team.add_member(user_id):
            user.add_team(team_id)
            return True
        return False
    
    def leave_team(self, user_id: str, team_id: str) -> bool:
        """Leave a team."""
        user = self.get_user(user_id)
        team = self.teams.get(team_id)
        
        if not user or not team:
            return False
        
        if user_id == team.created_by:
            raise ValueError("Team creator cannot leave the team")
        
        if team.remove_member(user_id):
            user.remove_team(team_id)
            return True
        return False
    
    # ========================================================================

        """Set a personal goal for a user."""
        user = self.get_user(user_id)
        if not user:
            raise ValueError(f"User {user_id} not found")
        
        goal = Goal(
            title=title,
            description=description,
            goal_type=goal_type,
            target_value=target_value,
            deadline=deadline
        )
        user.add_personal_goal(goal)
        return goal
    
    def set_team_goal(self, team_id: str, title: str, goal_type: GoalType,
                     target_value: float, deadline: datetime,
                     description: str = "") -> Goal:
        """Set a team goal."""
        team = self.teams.get(team_id)
        if not team:
            raise ValueError(f"Team {team_id} not found")
        
        goal = Goal(
            title=title,
            description=description,
            goal_type=goal_type,
            target_value=target_value,
            deadline=deadline
        )
        team.add_team_goal(goal)
        return goal

        """Update progress for a goal."""
        # Search in user's personal goals
        if user_id:
            user = self.get_user(user_id)
            if user:
                for goal in user.personal_goals:
                    if goal.goal_id == goal_id:
                        goal.current_value = current_value
                        self._check_goal_achievement(goal, user_id)
                        return True
        
        # Search in team goals

            if team:

                    if goal.goal_id == goal_id:
                        goal.current_value = current_value
                        self._check_team_goal_achievement(goal, team_id)
                        return True
        
        return False
    
    def _check_goal_achievement(self, goal: Goal, user_id: str) -> None:
        """Check if a personal goal has been achieved and notify user."""
        if goal.progress_percentage() >= 100:
            user = self.get_user(user_id)
            if user:
                notification = Notification(
                    title="Goal Achieved!",
                    message=f"Congratulations! You've achieved your goal: {goal.title}",
                    notification_type="achievement"
                )
                user.add_notification(notification)
    
    def _check_team_goal_achievement(self, goal: Goal, team_id: str) -> None:
        """Check if a team goal has been achieved and notify all team members."""

            team = self.teams.get(team_id)

                        user.add_notification(notification)

class HealthTeamSync:
    """Main application class for HealthTeamSync."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        """Initialize the application with empty data stores."""
        self.users: Dict[str, User] = {}
        self.teams: Dict[str, Team] = {}
        self.challenges: Dict[str, Challenge] = {}
        
    # ========================================================================
    # User Management
    # ========================================================================
    
    def register_user(self, username: str, email: str) -> User:
        """Register a new user."""
        if any(u.email == email for u in self.users.values()):
            raise ValueError(f"Email {email} already registered")
        
        user = User(username=username, email=email)
        self.users[user.user_id] = user
        return user
    
    def get_user(self, user_id: str) -> Optional[User]:
        """Get user by ID."""
        return self.users.get(user_id)
    
    # ========================================================================
    # Team Management
    # ========================================================================
    
    def create_team(self, name: str, description: str, creator_id: str) -> Team:
        """Create a new team."""
        if not self.get_user(creator_id):
            raise ValueError(f"User {creator_id} not found")
        
        # Check for unique team name
        if any(t.name == name for t in self.teams.values()):
            raise ValueError(f"Team name '{name}' already exists")
        
        team = Team(name=name, description=description, created_by=creator_id)
        team.add_member(creator_id)
        
        # Add team to user's team list
        user = self.users[creator_id]
        user.add_team(team.team_id)
        
        self.teams[team.team_id] = team
        return team
    
    def join_team(self, user_id: str, team_id: str) -> bool:
        """Join an existing team."""
        user = self.get_user(user_id)
        team = self.teams.get(team_id)
        
        if not user:
            raise ValueError(f"User {user_id} not found")
        if not team:
            raise ValueError(f"Team {team_id} not found")
        
        if team.add_member(user_id):
            user.add_team(team_id)
            return True
        return False
    
    def leave_team(self, user_id: str, team_id: str) -> bool:
        """Leave a team."""
        user = self.get_user(user_id)
        team = self.teams.get(team_id)
        
        if not user or not team:
            return False
        
        if user_id == team.created_by:
            raise ValueError("Team creator cannot leave the team")
        
        if team.remove_member(user_id):
            user.remove_team(team_id)
            return True
        return False

    # Goal Management
    # ========================================================================
    
    def set_personal_goal(self, user_id: str, title: str, goal_type: GoalType, 
                         target_value: float, deadline: datetime, 
                         description: str = "") -> Goal:
        """Set a personal goal for a user."""
        user = self.get_user(user_id)
        if not user:
            raise ValueError(f"User {user_id} not found")
        
        goal = Goal(
            title=title,
            description=description,
            goal_type=goal_type,
            target_value=target_value,
            deadline=deadline
        )
        user.add_personal_goal(goal)
        return goal
    
    def set_team_goal(self, team_id: str, title: str, goal_type: GoalType,
                     target_value: float, deadline: datetime,
                     description: str = "") -> Goal:
        """Set a team goal."""
        team = self.teams.get(team_id)
        if not team:
            raise ValueError(f"Team {team_id} not found")
        
        goal = Goal(
            title=title,
            description=description,
            goal_type=goal_type,
            target_value=target_value,
            deadline=deadline
        )
        team.add_team_goal(goal)
        return goal
    
    def update_goal_progress(self, goal_id: str, current_value: float, 
                           user_id: Optional[str] = None, 
                           team_id: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
        """Update progress for a goal."""
        # Search in user's personal goals
        if user_id:
            user = self.get_user(user_id)
            if user:
                for goal in user.personal_goals:
                    if goal.goal_id == goal_id:
                        goal.current_value = current_value
                        self._check_goal_achievement(goal, user_id)
                        return True
        
        # Search in team goals
        if team_id:
            team = self.teams.get(team_id)
            if team:
                for goal in team.team_goals:
                    if goal.goal_id == goal_id:
                        goal.current_value = current_value
                        self._check_team_goal_achievement(goal, team_id)
                        return True
        
        return False
    
    def _check_goal_achievement(self, goal: Goal, user_id: str) -> None:
        """Check if a personal goal has been achieved and notify user."""
        if goal.progress_percentage() >= 100:
            user = self.get_user(user_id)
            if user:
                notification = Notification(
                    title="Goal Achieved!",
                    message=f"Congratulations! You've achieved your goal: {goal.title}",
                    notification_type="achievement"
                )
                user.add_notification(notification)
    
    def _check_team_goal_achievement(self, goal: Goal, team_id: str) -> None:
        """Check if a team goal has been achieved and notify all team members."""
        if goal.progress_percentage() >= 100:
            team = self.teams.get(team_id)
            if team:
                for member_id in team.members:
                    user = self.get_user(member_id)
                    if user:
                        notification = Notification(
                            title="Team Goal Achieved!",
                            message=f"Your team has achieved the goal: {goal.title}",
                            notification_type="achievement"
                        )
                        user.add_notification(notification)

    def create_personal_challenge(self, user_id: str, title: str,

                                start_date: datetime, end_date: datetime,

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token")

def verify_password(plain_password, hashed_password):
    """Verify password against hash"""
    return pwd_context.verify(plain_password, hashed_password)

def get_password_hash(password):
    """Generate password hash"""
    return pwd_context.hash(password)

def authenticate_user(db: Session, username: str, password: str):
    """Authenticate user"""
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.username == username).first()
    if not user or not verify_password(password, user.hashed_password):
        return False
    return user

def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None):
    """Create JWT access token"""
    to_encode = data.copy()
    if expires_delta:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + expires_delta
    else:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    to_encode.update({"exp": expire})
    encoded_jwt = jwt.encode(to_encode, SECRET_KEY, algorithm=ALGORITHM)
    return encoded_jwt

async def get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Get current user from token"""
    credentials_exception = HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        detail="Could not validate credentials",
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
    )
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        username: str = payload.get("sub")
        if username is None:
            raise credentials_exception
        token_data = TokenData(username=username)
    except JWTError:
        raise credentials_exception
    
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.username == token_data.username).first()
    if user is None:
        raise credentials_exception
    return user

# ============================================================================

class ConnectionManager:
    """Manage WebSocket connections for real-time chat"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.active_connections: Dict[str, WebSocket] = {}
        self.user_connections: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}  # user_id -> [connection_ids]
    
    async def connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, user_id: str, connection_id: str):
        """Connect a user"""
        await websocket.accept()
        self.active_connections[connection_id] = websocket
        if user_id not in self.user_connections:
            self.user_connections[user_id] = []
        self.user_connections[user_id].append(connection_id)
    
    def disconnect(self, connection_id: str, user_id: str):
        """Disconnect a user"""
        if connection_id in self.active_connections:
            del self.active_connections[connection_id]
        if user_id in self.user_connections and connection_id in self.user_connections[user_id]:
            self.user_connections[user_id].remove(connection_id)
            if not self.user_connections[user_id]:
                del self.user_connections[user_id]
    
    async def send_personal_message(self, message: str, connection_id: str):
        """Send message to specific connection"""
        if connection_id in self.active_connections:
            await self.active_connections[connection_id].send_text(message)
    
    async def broadcast(self, message: str, exclude: List[str] = None):
        """Broadcast message to all connections"""
        exclude = exclude or []
        for connection_id, connection in self.active_connections.items():
            if connection_id not in exclude:
                await connection.send_text(message)

@app.post("/register", response_model=UserInDB)
async def register(user: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Register a new user"""
    # Check if username exists
    db_user = db.query(User).filter(User.username == user.username).first()
    if db_user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Username already registered")
    
    # Check if email exists
    db_email = db.query(User).filter(User.email == user.email).first()
    if db_email:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Email already registered")
    
    # Create new user
    hashed_password = get_password_hash(user.password)
    db_user = User(
        username=user.username,
        email=user.email,
        hashed_password=hashed_password,
        full_name=user.full_name,
        role=user.role,
        native_language=user.native_language,
        learning_language=user.learning_language,
        proficiency_level=user.proficiency_level
    )
    
    db.add(db_user)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_user)
    return db_user

@app.post("/token", response_model=Token)
async def login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Login and get access token"""
    user = authenticate_user(db, form_data.username, form_data.password)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Incorrect username or password",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )
    
    access_token_expires = timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    access_token = create_access_token(
        data={"sub": user.username}, expires_delta=access_token_expires
    )
    return {"access_token": access_token, "token_type": "bearer"}

@app.get("/users/me", response_model=UserInDB)
async def read_users_me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):

def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None):
    """Create JWT access token"""
    to_encode = data.copy()
    if expires_delta:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + expires_delta
    else:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    to_encode.update({"exp": expire})
    encoded_jwt = jwt.encode(to_encode, SECRET_KEY, algorithm=ALGORITHM)
    return encoded_jwt

async def get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Get current user from token"""
    credentials_exception = HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        detail="Could not validate credentials",
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
    )
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        username: str = payload.get("sub")
        if username is None:
            raise credentials_exception
        token_data = TokenData(username=username)
    except JWTError:
        raise credentials_exception
    
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.username == token_data.username).first()
    if user is None:
        raise credentials_exception
    return user

class ConnectionManager:
    """Manage WebSocket connections for real-time chat"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.active_connections: Dict[str, WebSocket] = {}
        self.user_connections: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}  # user_id -> [connection_ids]
    
    async def connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, user_id: str, connection_id: str):
        """Connect a user"""
        await websocket.accept()
        self.active_connections[connection_id] = websocket
        if user_id not in self.user_connections:
            self.user_connections[user_id] = []
        self.user_connections[user_id].append(connection_id)
    
    def disconnect(self, connection_id: str, user_id: str):
        """Disconnect a user"""
        if connection_id in self.active_connections:
            del self.active_connections[connection_id]
        if user_id in self.user_connections and connection_id in self.user_connections[user_id]:
            self.user_connections[user_id].remove(connection_id)
            if not self.user_connections[user_id]:
                del self.user_connections[user_id]
    
    async def send_personal_message(self, message: str, connection_id: str):
        """Send message to specific connection"""
        if connection_id in self.active_connections:
            await self.active_connections[connection_id].send_text(message)
    
    async def broadcast(self, message: str, exclude: List[str] = None):
        """Broadcast message to all connections"""
        exclude = exclude or []
        for connection_id, connection in self.active_connections.items():
            if connection_id not in exclude:
                await connection.send_text(message)

def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None):
    """Create JWT access token"""
    to_encode = data.copy()
    if expires_delta:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + expires_delta
    else:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)

class ConnectionManager:
    """Manage WebSocket connections for real-time chat"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.active_connections: Dict[str, WebSocket] = {}
        self.user_connections: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}  # user_id -> [connection_ids]
    
    async def connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, user_id: str, connection_id: str):
        """Connect a user"""
        await websocket.accept()
        self.active_connections[connection_id] = websocket
        if user_id not in self.user_connections:
            self.user_connections[user_id] = []
        self.user_connections[user_id].append(connection_id)
    
    def disconnect(self, connection_id: str, user_id: str):
        """Disconnect a user"""
        if connection_id in self.active_connections:
            del self.active_connections[connection_id]
        if user_id in self.user_connections and connection_id in self.user_connections[user_id]:
            self.user_connections[user_id].remove(connection_id)
            if not self.user_connections[user_id]:
                del self.user_connections[user_id]
    
    async def send_personal_message(self, message: str, connection_id: str):
        """Send message to specific connection"""
        if connection_id in self.active_connections:
            await self.active_connections[connection_id].send_text(message)
    
    async def broadcast(self, message: str, exclude: List[str] = None):
        """Broadcast message to all connections"""
        exclude = exclude or []
        for connection_id, connection in self.active_connections.items():
            if connection_id not in exclude:
                await connection.send_text(message)

@app.route('/api/register', methods=['POST'])
def register():
    """Register a new user"""
    data = request.json
    
    # Validate required fields
    required_fields = ['username', 'email', 'password', 'role', 'native_language']
    for field in required_fields:
        if field not in data:
            return jsonify({'error': f'Missing required field: {field}'}), 400
    
    # Check if user already exists
    if User.query.filter_by(username=data['username']).first():
        return jsonify({'error': 'Username already exists'}), 400
    if User.query.filter_by(email=data['email']).first():
        return jsonify({'error': 'Email already exists'}), 400
    
    # Create new user
    user = User(
        username=data['username'],
        email=data['email'],
        role=data['role'],
        native_language=data['native_language'],
        target_language=data.get('target_language'),
        level=data.get('level', 'beginner')
    )
    user.set_password(data['password'])
    
    # Save to database
    db.session.add(user)
    db.session.commit()
    
    # Log the action
    log_action(user.id, 'user_registration', {'role': user.role})
    
    return jsonify({
        'message': 'User registered successfully',
        'user_id': user.id,
        'username': user.username,
        'role': user.role
    }), 201


@app.route('/api/login', methods=['POST'])
def login():
    """User login endpoint"""
    data = request.json
    
    # Validate required fields
    if 'username' not in data or 'password' not in data:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Username and password required'}), 400
    
    # Find user
    user = User.query.filter_by(username=data['username']).first()
    
    # Check user exists and password is correct
    if not user or not user.check_password(data['password']):
        return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid username or password'}), 401
    
    # Check if user is active
    if not user.is_active:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Account is disabled'}), 403
    
    # Login user
    login_user(user)
    
    # Log the action
    log_action(user.id, 'user_login', {})
    
    return jsonify({
        'message': 'Login successful',
        'user_id': user.id,
        'username': user.username,
        'role': user.role,
        'permissions': user.get_role_permissions()
    }), 200

    if User.query.filter_by(username=data['username']).first():

        role=data['role'],
        native_language=data['native_language'],
        target_language=data.get('target_language'),
        level=data.get('level', 'beginner')

        self.cells[new_position] = piece_id

    status: EventStatus = EventStatus.PLANNING

    def calculate_budget_status(self) -> Tuple[float, float, float]:
        """Calculate budget summary: total budgeted, total actual, difference."""
        total_budgeted = sum(item.amount for item in self.budget_items)
        total_actual = sum(item.actual_amount for item in self.budget_items)
        difference = total_actual - total_budgeted
        return total_budgeted, total_actual, difference

    def calculate_task_progress(self) -> Tuple[int, int, float]:
        """Calculate task progress: completed tasks, total tasks, percentage."""
        total_tasks = len(self.tasks)
        if total_tasks == 0:
            return 0, 0, 0.0
        completed_tasks = sum(1 for task in self.tasks if task.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED)
        percentage = (completed_tasks / total_tasks) * 100
        return completed_tasks, total_tasks, percentage

        self.updated_at = datetime.datetime.now()

import os

class SecurityManager:
    """Centralized security management for HealthConnect"""
    
    def __init__(self, secret_key=None):
        self.secret_key = secret_key or os.getenv('SECRET_KEY', 'healthconnect-secret-key-2024')
        self.encryption_key = Fernet.generate_key()
        self.cipher = Fernet(self.encryption_key)
    
    def hash_password(self, password: str) -> str:
        """Hash password using bcrypt with salt"""
        salt = bcrypt.gensalt()
        hashed = bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode('utf-8'), salt)
        return hashed.decode('utf-8')
    
    def verify_password(self, password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
        """Verify password against hashed version"""
        return bcrypt.checkpw(password.encode('utf-8'), hashed_password.encode('utf-8'))
    
    def generate_token(self, user_id: str, user_type: str, expires_in: int = 3600) -> str:
        """Generate JWT token for authentication"""
        payload = {
            'user_id': user_id,
            'user_type': user_type,
            'exp': datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(seconds=expires_in),
            'iat': datetime.utcnow()
        }
        return jwt.encode(payload, self.secret_key, algorithm='HS256')
    
    def verify_token(self, token: str) -> dict:
        """Verify JWT token and return payload"""
        try:
            payload = jwt.decode(token, self.secret_key, algorithms=['HS256'])
            return payload
        except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError:
            raise ValueError("Token has expired")
        except jwt.InvalidTokenError:
            raise ValueError("Invalid token")
    
    def encrypt_data(self, data: str) -> str:
        """Encrypt sensitive data using Fernet symmetric encryption"""
        encrypted = self.cipher.encrypt(data.encode('utf-8'))
        return encrypted.decode('utf-8')
    
    def decrypt_data(self, encrypted_data: str) -> str:
        """Decrypt encrypted data"""
        decrypted = self.cipher.decrypt(encrypted_data.encode('utf-8'))
        return decrypted.decode('utf-8')
    
    def create_audit_log(self, session, user_id, action, resource_type=None, resource_id=None, details=None):
        """Create audit log entry for HIPAA compliance"""

import jwt
import secrets
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from functools import wraps
import base64

class SecurityManager:
    """Security manager for authentication, authorization, and encryption"""
    
    def __init__(self, secret_key: str = None):
        self.secret_key = secret_key or secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
        self.token_expiry_hours = 24
    
    def generate_token(self, user_id: int, username: str, role: str) -> str:
        """Generate JWT token for authenticated user"""
        payload = {
            'user_id': user_id,
            'username': username,
            'role': role,
            'exp': datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(hours=self.token_expiry_hours),
            'iat': datetime.utcnow()
        }
        
        return jwt.encode(payload, self.secret_key, algorithm='HS256')
    
    def verify_token(self, token: str) -> Optional[Dict]:
        """Verify JWT token and return payload if valid"""
        try:
            payload = jwt.decode(token, self.secret_key, algorithms=['HS256'])
            return payload
        except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError:
            print("Token has expired")
            return None
        except jwt.InvalidTokenError:
            print("Invalid token")
            return None
    
    def encrypt_data(self, data: str) -> str:
        """Simple encryption for sensitive data (in production, use stronger encryption)"""
        # This is a simplified version - in production, use proper encryption like AES
        encoded = base64.b64encode(data.encode()).decode()
        # Add a simple salt/rotation
        salt = secrets.token_urlsafe(8)
        return f"{salt}:{encoded}"
    
    def decrypt_data(self, encrypted_data: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Decrypt data"""
        try:
            if ':' in encrypted_data:
                salt, encoded = encrypted_data.split(':', 1)
                return base64.b64decode(encoded).decode()
            return None
        except:
            return None
    
    def check_permission(self, user_role: str, required_role: str) -> bool:
        """Check if user has required role permission"""
        role_hierarchy = {'admin': 3, 'doctor': 2, 'patient': 1}
        return role_hierarchy.get(user_role, 0) >= role_hierarchy.get(required_role, 0)

class BaseAgent(ABC):

            "activity": activity,
            "details": details or {}
        }
        self.log.append(log_entry)
    
    @abstractmethod

        """Abstract method to be implemented by concrete agents"""
        pass

            treatment_plan: Current treatment plan

            List of generated alerts
        """
        self.log_activity("monitor_patient", {"patient_id": patient_data.patient_id})

        # Check health metrics against thresholds

            "blood_pressure": {"systolic": 140, "diastolic": 90},
            "blood_sugar": {"fasting": 130, "post_prandial": 180},
            "weight": {"weekly_change": 2}  # kg
        }
        
        for metric_name, metric_value in patient_data.health_metrics.items():
            threshold = thresholds.get(metric_name)
            
            if threshold and isinstance(metric_value, dict):
                # For complex metrics like blood pressure
                if metric_name == "blood_pressure":
                    systolic = metric_value.get("systolic", 0)
                    diastolic = metric_value.get("diastolic", 0)
                    
                    if systolic > threshold["systolic"] or diastolic > threshold["diastolic"]:
                        alert = Alert(
                            alert_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
                            patient_id=patient_id,
                            message=f"High blood pressure detected: {systolic}/{diastolic}",
                            severity="high",

                        )
                        alerts.append(alert)

                        patient_id=patient_id,

class Budget:
    """Main Budget class for BudgetSync"""
    
    def __init__(self, budget_id: str, name: str, owner_id: str):
        self.budget_id = budget_id
        self.name = name
        self.owner_id = owner_id
        self.created_at = datetime.datetime.now()
        self.categories: Dict[str, BudgetCategory] = {}
        self.goals: Dict[str, BudgetGoal] = {}
        self.transactions: List[Transaction] = []
        self.members: Dict[str, BudgetMember] = {owner_id: BudgetMember(owner_id, UserRole.OWNER, datetime.datetime.now())}
        self.notifications: List[Notification] = []
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        
    def add_member(self, user_id: str, role: UserRole = UserRole.VIEWER) -> bool:
        """Add a new member to the budget"""
        with self.lock:
            if user_id in self.members:
                return False
            self.members[user_id] = BudgetMember(user_id, role, datetime.datetime.now())
            
            # Create notification
            notification = Notification(
                notification_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
                user_id=user_id,
                budget_id=self.budget_id,
                type=NotificationType.NEW_USER_ADDED,
                message=f"You have been added to budget '{self.name}' as {role.value}",
                created_at=datetime.datetime.now()
            )
            self.notifications.append(notification)
            return True
    
    def add_transaction(self, transaction: Transaction) -> bool:
        """Add a transaction to the budget"""
        with self.lock:
            # Update category spent amount
            if transaction.category_id in self.categories:
                category = self.categories[transaction.category_id]
                if transaction.type == TransactionType.EXPENSE:
                    category.spent_amount += transaction.amount
                    
                    # Check if category budget exceeded
                    if category.spent_amount > category.allocated_amount:
                        self._create_notification(
                            NotificationType.BUDGET_EXCEEDED,
                            f"Category '{category.name}' exceeded budget by ${category.spent_amount - category.allocated_amount:.2f}",
                            transaction.user_id
                        )
                else:  # Income
                    # For income categories, we might handle differently
                    pass
            
            self.transactions.append(transaction)
            
            # Update goals if this is income
            if transaction.type == TransactionType.INCOME:
                for goal in self.goals.values():
                    if not goal.achieved:
                        goal.update_progress(transaction.amount)
                        if goal.achieved:
                            self._create_notification(
                                NotificationType.GOAL_REACHED,
                                f"Goal '{goal.name}' has been reached!",
                                transaction.user_id
                            )
            
            return True
    
    def _create_notification(self, type: NotificationType, message: str, user_id: str):
        """Create a notification"""
        notification = Notification(
            notification_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
            user_id=user_id,
            budget_id=self.budget_id,
            type=type,
            message=message,
            created_at=datetime.datetime.now()
        )
        self.notifications.append(notification)\

            conn.commit()
    
    @contextmanager
    def _get_connection(self):
        """Context manager for database connections"""
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        try:
            yield conn
        finally:
            conn.close()
    
    def execute_query(self, query: str, params: tuple = ()) -> List[Dict]:
        """Execute a SELECT query and return results as dictionaries"""
        with self._get_connection() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(query, params)
            return [dict(row) for row in cursor.fetchall()]
    
    def execute_update(self, query: str, params: tuple = ()) -> int:
        """Execute an INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE query and return last row ID"""
        with self._get_connection() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(query, params)
            conn.commit()
            return cursor.lastrowid

class AuthenticationService:
    """Handles user authentication and authorization"""
    
    def __init__(self, db_manager: DatabaseManager):
        self.db_manager = db_manager
    
    def hash_password(self, password: str) -> str:
        """Hash password for secure storage"""
        salt = secrets.token_hex(16)
        return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac(
            'sha256',
            password.encode('utf-8'),
            salt.encode('utf-8'),
            100000
        ).hex() + ':' + salt
    
    def verify_password(self, stored_password: str, provided_password: str) -> bool:
        """Verify password against stored hash"""
        password_hash, salt = stored_password.split(':')
        new_hash = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac(
            'sha256',
            provided_password.encode('utf-8'),
            salt.encode('utf-8'),
            100000
        ).hex()
        return password_hash == new_hash
    
    def register_user(self, username: str, email: str, password: str, 
                     date_of_birth: str = None, gender: str = None) -> Optional[User]:
        """Register a new user"""
        try:
            user_id = secrets.token_hex(16)
            password_hash = self.hash_password(password)
            
            query = '''
                INSERT INTO users (user_id, username, email, password_hash, 
                                 date_of_birth, gender)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            '''
            self.db_manager.execute_update(
                query, 
                (user_id, username, email, password_hash, date_of_birth, gender)
            )
            
            return User(user_id, username, email, password_hash, date_of_birth, gender)
        except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
            return None
    
    def login(self, username: str, password: str) -> Optional[User]:
        """Authenticate user"""
        query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?"
        users = self.db_manager.execute_query(query, (username,))
        
        if users and self.verify_password(users[0]['password_hash'], password):
            return User(**users[0])
        return None

    def __init__(self, db_manager: DatabaseManager):

    def create_reminder(self, user_id: str, reminder_type: str, 
                       frequency: str = "daily") -> Reminder:
        """Create a new reminder"""
        next_reminder = self._calculate_next_reminder(frequency)
        query = '''
            INSERT INTO reminders (user_id, reminder_type, frequency, next_reminder)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        '''

        )
        
        return Reminder(reminder_id, user_id, reminder_type, 
                       frequency, next_reminder, True)
    
    def _calculate_next_reminder(self, frequency: str) -> str:
        """Calculate next reminder time based on frequency"""
        now = datetime.datetime.now()
        
        if frequency == "daily":
            next_time = now + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
        elif frequency == "weekly":
            next_time = now + datetime.timedelta(weeks=1)
        elif frequency == "twice_daily":
            next_time = now + datetime.timedelta(hours=12)

class RecommendationEngine:
    """Machine learning engine for generating health insights and recommendations"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.scaler = StandardScaler()
        self.cluster_model = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=42)
        
    def analyze_symptom_patterns(self, symptoms_data):
        """Analyze symptom patterns to identify clusters and trends"""
        if len(symptoms_data) < 5:
            return {"status": "insufficient_data", "message": "More data needed for analysis"}
        
        # Prepare data for clustering
        features = []
        for symptom in symptoms_data:
            features.append([
                symptom['severity'],
                symptom['duration_hours'],
                symptom['timestamp'].hour if hasattr(symptom['timestamp'], 'hour') else 12
            ])
        
        features = np.array(features)
        features_scaled = self.scaler.fit_transform(features)
        
        # Perform clustering
        clusters = self.cluster_model.fit_predict(features_scaled)
        
        # Analyze clusters
        insights = []
        unique_clusters = np.unique(clusters)
        
        for cluster_id in unique_clusters:
            cluster_indices = np.where(clusters == cluster_id)[0]
            cluster_symptoms = [symptoms_data[i] for i in cluster_indices]
            
            # Calculate cluster statistics
            avg_severity = np.mean([s['severity'] for s in cluster_symptoms])
            avg_duration = np.mean([s['duration_hours'] for s in cluster_symptoms])
            common_times = np.bincount([s['timestamp'].hour if hasattr(s['timestamp'], 'hour') 
                                       else 12 for s in cluster_symptoms]).argmax()
            
            insight = {
                'cluster_id': int(cluster_id),
                'avg_severity': float(avg_severity),
                'avg_duration': float(avg_duration),
                'common_time_of_day': int(common_times),
                'symptom_count': len(cluster_symptoms),
                'recommendations': self._generate_cluster_recommendations(avg_severity, avg_duration, common_times)
            }
            insights.append(insight)
        
        return {
            'status': 'success',
            'total_symptoms_analyzed': len(symptoms_data),
            'clusters_identified': len(unique_clusters),
            'insights': insights
        }
    
    def _generate_cluster_recommendations(self, avg_severity, avg_duration, common_time):
        """Generate recommendations based on cluster analysis"""
        recommendations = []
        
        if avg_severity > 7:
            recommendations.append("Consider consulting a healthcare professional for high severity symptoms")
        
        if avg_duration > 24:
            recommendations.append("Persistent symptoms lasting more than 24 hours should be evaluated by a doctor")
        
        if common_time in [8, 12, 18]:  # Common meal times
            recommendations.append("Symptoms may be related to meal times. Consider keeping a food diary")
        
        if len(recommendations) == 0:
            recommendations.append("Continue monitoring symptoms and maintain regular health check-ups")
        
        return recommendations
    
    def predict_potential_triggers(self, symptoms_data, user_profile):
        """Predict potential triggers based on symptom patterns and user profile"""
        triggers = {}
        
        # Time-based triggers
        morning_symptoms = [s for s in symptoms_data 
                           if hasattr(s['timestamp'], 'hour') and 5 <= s['timestamp'].hour <= 11]
        if len(morning_symptoms) > len(symptoms_data) * 0.4:
            triggers['time_of_day'] = 'Morning'
        
        # Severity patterns
        high_severity_days = [s for s in symptoms_data if s['severity'] >= 7]
        if len(high_severity_days) > 3:
            triggers['high_severity_pattern'] = 'Multiple high severity episodes detected'
        
        # Duration patterns
        long_duration = [s for s in symptoms_data if s['duration_hours'] > 12]
        if len(long_duration) > 2:
            triggers['long_duration'] = 'Symptoms persisting for extended periods'
        
        return triggers
    
    def generate_personalized_recommendations(self, user_id, symptoms_data, conditions):
        """Generate personalized recommendations for a specific user"""
        recommendations = []
        
        # Analyze symptom patterns
        pattern_analysis = self.analyze_symptom_patterns(symptoms_data)
        
        if pattern_analysis['status'] == 'success':
            for insight in pattern_analysis['insights']:
                for rec in insight['recommendations']:
                    recommendations.append(rec)
        
        # Condition-specific recommendations
        for condition in conditions:
            if 'headache' in condition['condition_name'].lower():
                recommendations.append("For headache management: Ensure adequate hydration and consider stress reduction techniques")
            if 'allergy' in condition['condition_name'].lower():
                recommendations.append("For allergies: Monitor pollen counts and consider antihistamines as recommended by your doctor")
        
        # General health recommendations
        if len(symptoms_data) > 10:

            if symptom_frequency > 0.5:
                recommendations.append("Frequent symptoms detected. Consider keeping a detailed symptom diary for your next doctor's visit")

class ConnectionManager:
    """Manages WebSocket connections for real-time collaboration"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.active_connections: Dict[str, List[WebSocket]] = {}
        self.user_connections: Dict[str, WebSocket] = {}
        
    async def connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, project_id: str, user_id: str):
        """Connect a user to a project"""
        await websocket.accept()
        
        if project_id not in self.active_connections:
            self.active_connections[project_id] = []
        
        self.active_connections[project_id].append(websocket)
        self.user_connections[user_id] = websocket
        
    def disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket, project_id: str, user_id: str):
        """Disconnect a user from a project"""
        if project_id in self.active_connections:
            self.active_connections[project_id].remove(websocket)
            if not self.active_connections[project_id]:
                del self.active_connections[project_id]
        
        if user_id in self.user_connections:
            del self.user_connections[user_id]
            
    async def broadcast_to_project(self, project_id: str, message: dict):
        """Broadcast a message to all users in a project"""
        if project_id in self.active_connections:
            for connection in self.active_connections[project_id]:
                try:
                    await connection.send_json(message)
                except Exception:
                    pass
                    
    async def send_to_user(self, user_id: str, message: dict):
        """Send a message to a specific user"""
        if user_id in self.user_connections:
            try:
                await self.user_connections[user_id].send_json(message)
            except Exception:
                pass

class MusicEngine:
    """Handles music generation and processing"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def generate_waveform(note: Note, sample_rate: int = 44100):
        """Generate a simple sine wave for a note"""
        t = np.linspace(0, note.duration, int(sample_rate * note.duration), False)
        
        # Convert MIDI note to frequency
        frequency = 440 * (2 ** ((note.pitch - 69) / 12))
        
        # Generate sine wave with envelope
        wave = np.sin(frequency * 2 * np.pi * t)
        
        # Apply simple ADSR envelope
        attack = 0.01
        decay = 0.1
        sustain = 0.7
        release = 0.2
        
        envelope = np.zeros_like(t)
        n_samples = len(t)
        attack_samples = int(attack * sample_rate)
        decay_samples = int(decay * sample_rate)
        release_samples = int(release * sample_rate)
        
        if attack_samples > 0:
            envelope[:attack_samples] = np.linspace(0, 1, attack_samples)
        
        if decay_samples > 0:
            envelope[attack_samples:attack_samples+decay_samples] = np.linspace(1, sustain, decay_samples)
        
        sustain_samples = n_samples - attack_samples - decay_samples - release_samples
        if sustain_samples > 0:
            envelope[attack_samples+decay_samples:attack_samples+decay_samples+sustain_samples] = sustain
        
        if release_samples > 0:
            envelope[attack_samples+decay_samples+sustain_samples:] = np.linspace(
                sustain, 0, min(release_samples, n_samples - (attack_samples+decay_samples+sustain_samples))
            )
        
        # Apply velocity
        amplitude = note.velocity / 127.0
        wave = wave * envelope * amplitude
        
        return wave
    
    @staticmethod
    def generate_audio(project_data: ProjectData, sample_rate: int = 44100):
        """Generate audio from project data"""
        # Find maximum duration
        max_duration = 0
        for track in project_data.tracks:
            for note in track.notes:
                max_duration = max(max_duration, note.start_time + note.duration)
        
        if max_duration == 0:
            max_duration = 10  # Default duration
        
        # Create empty audio buffer
        total_samples = int(sample_rate * max_duration)
        audio = np.zeros(total_samples)
        
        # Mix all notes
        for track in project_data.tracks:
            for note in track.notes:
                wave = MusicEngine.generate_waveform(note, sample_rate)
                start_sample = int(note.start_time * sample_rate)
                end_sample = start_sample + len(wave)
                
                if end_sample <= total_samples:
                    audio[start_sample:end_sample] += wave
        
        # Normalize audio
        max_amplitude = np.max(np.abs(audio))
        if max_amplitude > 0:
            audio = audio / max_amplitude * 0.8
        
        # Convert to 16-bit PCM
        audio_int16 = (audio * 32767).astype(np.int16)
        
        # Create WAV file in memory
        buffer = io.BytesIO()
        wavfile.write(buffer, sample_rate, audio_int16)
        buffer.seek(0)
        
        return buffer
    
    @staticmethod
    def analyze_sentiment(text: str) -> SentimentAnalysis:
        """Perform basic sentiment analysis on lyrics"""
        positive_words = ["love", "happy", "joy", "peace", "beautiful", "wonderful", "amazing"]
        negative_words = ["hate", "sad", "pain", "death", "lonely", "cry", "angry"]
        
        words = text.lower().split()
        positive_count = sum(1 for word in words if word in positive_words)
        negative_count = sum(1 for word in words if word in negative_words)
        total_words = len(words)
        
        if total_words == 0:
            return SentimentAnalysis(
                sentiment="neutral",
                confidence=1.0,
                themes=[]
            )
        
        positive_score = positive_count / total_words
        negative_score = negative_count / total_words
        
        if positive_score > negative_score:
            sentiment = "positive"
            confidence = positive_score
        elif negative_score > positive_score:
            sentiment = "negative"
            confidence = negative_score
        else:
            sentiment = "neutral"
            confidence = 0.5
        
        # Identify themes
        themes = []
        theme_words = {
            "love": ["love", "heart", "kiss", "romance"],
            "nature": ["sky", "tree", "flower", "river", "mountain"],
            "sadness": ["sad", "cry", "tear", "lonely", "miss"],
            "joy": ["happy", "joy", "laugh", "smile", "dance"]
        }
        
        for theme, keywords in theme_words.items():
            if any(keyword in text.lower() for keyword in keywords):
                themes.append(theme)
        
        return SentimentAnalysis(
            sentiment=sentiment,
            confidence=confidence,
            themes=themes
        )
    
    @staticmethod
    def generate_suggestions(project_data: ProjectData) -> List[MusicalSuggestion]:
        """Generate musical suggestions based on current composition"""
        suggestions = []
        
        # Analyze melody and suggest harmonies
        if project_data.tracks:
            main_track = project_data.tracks[0]
            if main_track.notes:
                # Suggest chord progression
                notes = [note.pitch for note in main_track.notes[:4]]
                if len(notes) >= 3:
                    chord = notes[:3]
                    suggestion = MusicalSuggestion(
                        type="harmony",
                        description="Suggested chord progression based on melody",
                        notes=[
                            Note(pitch=chord[0]+12, velocity=80, start_time=0, duration=2),
                            Note(pitch=chord[1]+12, velocity=80, start_time=0, duration=2),
                            Note(pitch=chord[2]+12, velocity=80, start_time=0, duration=2),
                        ],
                        confidence=0.7
                    )
                    suggestions.append(suggestion)
        
        # Suggest rhythm variations
        suggestion = MusicalSuggestion(
            type="rhythm",
            description="Try syncopated rhythm pattern",
            notes=[
                Note(pitch=60, velocity=100, start_time=0, duration=0.5),
                Note(pitch=60, velocity=80, start_time=1, duration=0.5),
                Note(pitch=60, velocity=90, start_time=1.5, duration=0.5),
            ],
            confidence=0.6
        )
        suggestions.append(suggestion)
        
        return suggestions

class VersionControl:
    """Manages project versioning"""
    
    def __init__(self, db_session):
        self.db = db_session
    
    def create_version(self, project_id: str, user_id: str, 
                      content: dict, notes: str = None) -> str:
        """Create a new version of a project"""
        # Get current version number
        from sqlalchemy import func
        from sqlalchemy.exc import NoResultFound
        
        try:
            max_version = self.db.query(func.max(ProjectVersion.version_number)).filter(
                ProjectVersion.project_id == project_id
            ).scalar() or 0
        except NoResultFound:
            max_version = 0
        
        new_version = max_version + 1
        
        version = ProjectVersion(
            id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
            project_id=project_id,
            version_number=new_version,
            content=content,
            created_by=user_id,
            notes=notes,
            created_at=datetime.utcnow()
        )
        
        self.db.add(version)
        self.db.commit()
        
        return version.id
    
    def get_version(self, project_id: str, version_number: int) -> Optional[dict]:
        """Get a specific version of a project"""
        version = self.db.query(ProjectVersion).filter(
            ProjectVersion.project_id == project_id,
            ProjectVersion.version_number == version_number
        ).first()
        
        return version.content if version else None
    
    def get_version_history(self, project_id: str) -> List[dict]:
        """Get version history for a project"""
        versions = self.db.query(ProjectVersion).filter(
            ProjectVersion.project_id == project_id
        ).order_by(ProjectVersion.version_number.desc()).all()
        
        return [
            {
                "version_number": v.version_number,
                "created_by": v.created_by,
                "created_at": v.created_at,
                "notes": v.notes
            }
            for v in versions
        ]
    
    def revert_to_version(self, project_id: str, version_number: int) -> dict:
        """Revert project to a specific version"""
        version = self.db.query(ProjectVersion).filter(
            ProjectVersion.project_id == project_id,
            ProjectVersion.version_number == version_number
        ).first()
        
        if not version:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Version not found")
        
        return version.content

class AuthHandler:
    """Handles user authentication and authorization"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
        """Hash a password for storage"""
        return hashlib.sha256(password.encode()).hexdigest()
    
    @staticmethod
    def verify_password(password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
        """Verify a password against its hash"""
        return hashlib.sha256(password.encode()).hexdigest() == hashed_password
    
    @staticmethod
    def get_current_user(
        credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security),
        db: Session = Depends(lambda: get_db())
    ) -> User:
        """Get current user from authorization token"""
        user = db.query(User).filter(User.id == credentials.credentials).first()
        if not user:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid authentication credentials")
        return user

        decay = 0.1
        sustain = 0.7
        release = 0.2
        
        envelope = np.zeros_like(t)
        n_samples = len(t)
        attack_samples = int(attack * sample_rate)
        decay_samples = int(decay * sample_rate)
        release_samples = int(release * sample_rate)
        
        if attack_samples > 0:
            envelope[:attack_samples] = np.linspace(0, 1, attack_samples)
        
        if decay_samples > 0:
            envelope[attack_samples:attack_samples+decay_samples] = np.linspace(1, sustain, decay_samples)
        
        sustain_samples = n_samples - attack_samples - decay_samples - release_samples
        if sustain_samples > 0:
            envelope[attack_samples+decay_samples:attack_samples+decay_samples+sustain_samples] = sustain
        
        if release_samples > 0:
            envelope[attack_samples+decay_samples+sustain_samples:] = np.linspace(
                sustain, 0, min(release_samples, n_samples - (attack_samples+decay_samples+sustain_samples))
            )
        
        # Apply velocity
        amplitude = note.velocity / 127.0
        wave = wave * envelope * amplitude
        
        return wave
    
    @staticmethod
    def generate_audio(project_data: ProjectData, sample_rate: int = 44100):
        """Generate audio from project data"""
        # Find maximum duration
        max_duration = 0
        for track in project_data.tracks:
            for note in track.notes:
                max_duration = max(max_duration, note.start_time + note.duration)
        
        if max_duration == 0:
            max_duration = 10  # Default duration
        
        # Create empty audio buffer
        total_samples = int(sample_rate * max_duration)
        audio = np.zeros(total_samples)
        
        # Mix all notes
        for track in project_data.tracks:
            for note in track.notes:
                wave = MusicEngine.generate_waveform(note, sample_rate)
                start_sample = int(note.start_time * sample_rate)
                end_sample = start_sample + len(wave)
                
                if end_sample <= total_samples:
                    audio[start_sample:end_sample] += wave
        
        # Normalize audio
        max_amplitude = np.max(np.abs(audio))
        if max_amplitude > 0:
            audio = audio / max_amplitude * 0.8
        
        # Convert to 16-bit PCM
        audio_int16 = (audio * 32767).astype(np.int16)
        
        # Create WAV file in memory
        buffer = io.BytesIO()
        wavfile.write(buffer, sample_rate, audio_int16)
        buffer.seek(0)
        
        return buffer
    
    @staticmethod
    def analyze_sentiment(text: str) -> SentimentAnalysis:
        """Perform basic sentiment analysis on lyrics"""
        positive_words = ["love", "happy", "joy", "peace", "beautiful", "wonderful", "amazing"]
        negative_words = ["hate", "sad", "pain", "death", "lonely", "cry", "angry"]
        
        words = text.lower().split()
        positive_count = sum(1 for word in words if word in positive_words)
        negative_count = sum(1 for word in words if word in negative_words)
        total_words = len(words)
        
        if total_words == 0:
            return SentimentAnalysis(
                sentiment="neutral",
                confidence=1.0,
                themes=[]
            )
        
        positive_score = positive_count / total_words
        negative_score = negative_count / total_words
        
        if positive_score > negative_score:
            sentiment = "positive"
            confidence = positive_score
        elif negative_score > positive_score:
            sentiment = "negative"
            confidence = negative_score
        else:
            sentiment = "neutral"
            confidence = 0.5
        
        # Identify themes
        themes = []
        theme_words = {
            "love": ["love", "heart", "kiss", "romance"],
            "nature": ["sky", "tree", "flower", "river", "mountain"],
            "sadness": ["sad", "cry", "tear", "lonely", "miss"],
            "joy": ["happy", "joy", "laugh", "smile", "dance"]
        }
        
        for theme, keywords in theme_words.items():
            if any(keyword in text.lower() for keyword in keywords):
                themes.append(theme)
        
        return SentimentAnalysis(
            sentiment=sentiment,
            confidence=confidence,
            themes=themes
        )

class VersionControl:
    """Manages project versioning"""
    
    def __init__(self, db_session):
        self.db = db_session
    
    def create_version(self, project_id: str, user_id: str, 
                      content: dict, notes: str = None) -> str:
        """Create a new version of a project"""
        # Get current version number
        from sqlalchemy import func
        from sqlalchemy.exc import NoResultFound
        
        try:
            max_version = self.db.query(func.max(ProjectVersion.version_number)).filter(
                ProjectVersion.project_id == project_id
            ).scalar() or 0
        except NoResultFound:
            max_version = 0
        
        new_version = max_version + 1
        
        version = ProjectVersion(
            id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
            project_id=project_id,
            version_number=new_version,
            content=content,
            created_by=user_id,
            notes=notes,
            created_at=datetime.utcnow()
        )
        
        self.db.add(version)
        self.db.commit()
        
        return version.id
    
    def get_version(self, project_id: str, version_number: int) -> Optional[dict]:
        """Get a specific version of a project"""
        version = self.db.query(ProjectVersion).filter(
            ProjectVersion.project_id == project_id,
            ProjectVersion.version_number == version_number
        ).first()
        
        return version.content if version else None
    
    def get_version_history(self, project_id: str) -> List[dict]:
        """Get version history for a project"""
        versions = self.db.query(ProjectVersion).filter(
            ProjectVersion.project_id == project_id
        ).order_by(ProjectVersion.version_number.desc()).all()
        
        return [
            {
                "version_number": v.version_number,
                "created_by": v.created_by,
                "created_at": v.created_at,
                "notes": v.notes
            }
            for v in versions
        ]
    
    def revert_to_version(self, project_id: str, version_number: int) -> dict:
        """Revert project to a specific version"""
        version = self.db.query(ProjectVersion).filter(
            ProjectVersion.project_id == project_id,
            ProjectVersion.version_number == version_number
        ).first()
        
        if not version:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Version not found")
        
        return version.content

async def upload_midi_file(
    project_id: str,
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    track_name: Optional[str] = Form(None),
    merge_strategy: str = Form("append"),
    current_user: User = Depends(AuthHandler.get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    """Upload and parse MIDI file into project"""
    # Check if project exists and user has access
    project = db.query(Project).filter(Project.id == project_id).first()
    if not project:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Project not found")
    
    if current_user.id not in project.collaborators:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Not authorized to access this project")
    
    # Validate file type
    if not file.filename.lower().endswith(('.mid', '.midi')):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="File must be a MIDI file (.mid or .midi)")
    
    # Read file content
    file_content = await file.read()
    
    # Parse MIDI file
    try:
        tracks = MusicEngine.parse_midi_file(file_content)
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Failed to parse MIDI file: {str(e)}")
    
    if not tracks:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="No valid tracks found in MIDI file")
    
    # Get current project data
    version_control = VersionControl(db)
    current_version = version_control.get_version(project_id, project.metadata.get("current_version", 1))
    
    if not current_version:
        current_data = ProjectData()
    else:
        current_data = ProjectData(**current_version)
    
    # Apply merge strategy
    if merge_strategy == "replace":
        # Replace all tracks with MIDI tracks
        current_data.tracks = tracks
    elif merge_strategy == "new_track" and track_name:
        # Add as a single new track with custom name
        if tracks:
            merged_track = Track(
                id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
                name=track_name,
                notes=[],
                instrument="piano",
                color=f"#{hashlib.md5(track_name.encode()).hexdigest()[:6]}"
            )
            for track in tracks:
                merged_track.notes.extend(track.notes)
            current_data.tracks.append(merged_track)
    else:  # Default: append
        # Append all tracks with optional renaming
        for i, track in enumerate(tracks):
            if track_name and i == 0:
                track.name = track_name
            current_data.tracks.append(track)
    
    # Update project version
    current_data.version += 1
    
    # Create new version
    version_id = version_control.create_version(
        project_id=project_id,
        user_id=current_user.id,
        content=current_data.dict(),
        notes=f"Added MIDI file: {file.filename}"
    )
    
    # Update project metadata
    project.updated_at = datetime.utcnow()
    project.metadata["current_version"] = current_data.version
    db.commit()
    
    # Broadcast update to all connected users
    await connection_manager.broadcast_to_project(project_id, {
        "type": "project_updated",
        "data": {
            "version": current_data.version,
            "tracks_count": len(current_data.tracks),
            "message": f"MIDI file '{file.filename}' uploaded by {current_user.username}"
        }
    })
    
    return {
        "success": True,
        "tracks_added": len(tracks),
        "total_tracks": len(current_data.tracks),
        "version": current_data.version,
        "version_id": version_id
    }"}]}}

class SentimentAnalyzer:
    """Basic sentiment analysis for lyrics"""
    @staticmethod
    def analyze(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Analyze sentiment of lyrics"""
        positive_words = ["love", "happy", "joy", "peace", "hope"]
        negative_words = ["hate", "sad", "pain", "fear", "death"]
        
        words = text.lower().split()
        positive_count = sum(1 for word in words if word in positive_words)
        negative_count = sum(1 for word in words if word in negative_words)
        
        sentiment_score = (positive_count - negative_count) / max(len(words), 1)
        
        themes = []
        if any(word in words for word in ["love", "heart", "kiss"]):
            themes.append("romance")
        if any(word in words for word in ["sky", "sun", "star"]):
            themes.append("nature")
        if any(word in words for word in ["life", "time", "dream"]):
            themes.append("philosophy")
        
        return {
            "sentiment": "positive" if sentiment_score > 0 else "negative" if sentiment_score < 0 else "neutral",
            "score": sentiment_score,
            "themes": themes,
            "word_count": len(words)
        }

class MusicTheorySuggestions:
    """Generate musical suggestions based on current composition"""
    @staticmethod
    def suggest_harmony(melody_notes: List[str]) -> List[str]:
        """Suggest harmonies for given melody notes"""
        harmony_map = {
            "C": ["E", "G"],
            "D": ["F", "A"],
            "E": ["G", "B"],
            "F": ["A", "C"],
            "G": ["B", "D"],
            "A": ["C", "E"],
            "B": ["D", "F"]
        }
        
        harmonies = []
        for note in melody_notes:
            base_note = note[0] if note[0] in harmony_map else "C"
            harmonies.extend(harmony_map.get(base_note, ["E", "G"]))
        
        return list(set(harmonies))[:3]
    
    @staticmethod
    def suggest_melody_variation(current_melody: List[str]) -> List[str]:
        """Suggest variations for current melody"""
        variations = []
        for note in current_melody:
            if note.endswith("4"):
                variations.append(note.replace("4", "5"))
            else:

# Main application class
class MusicCollaborator:
    """Main application class for collaborative music composition"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.users: Dict[str, User] = {}
        self.projects: Dict[str, Project] = {}
        self.user_sessions: Dict[str, WebSocket] = {}
        self.active_projects: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}  # project_id -> list of user_ids
        
        # Initialize with sample data
        self._initialize_sample_data()

                MusicalElement(id="note2", type="note", value="E4", duration=1.0, position=1.0),
                MusicalElement(id="note3", type="note", value="G4", duration=1.0, position=2.0),
            ],

                Lyrics(
                    id="lyric1",
