                    position=0.0,
                    duration=4.0,
                    author_id="user3",
                    created_at=datetime.now(),
                    sentiment_analysis=SentimentAnalyzer.analyze("Music brings us together")
                )
            ],
            tempo=120,
            time_signature="4/4",
            author_id="user1"
        )
        
        project.current_version = version
        project.versions.append(version)
        project.collaborators = ["user1", "user2", "user3"]
        
        self.projects[project_id] = project
        self.active_projects[project_id] = []
    
    # User management
    def register_user(self, username: str, email: str, role: UserRole) -> User:
        """Register a new user"""
        user_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        user = User(
            id=user_id,
            username=username,
            email=email,
            role=role
        )
        self.users[user_id] = user
        return user
    
    def login_user(self, user_id: str, websocket: WebSocket) -> bool:
        """Log in a user and establish WebSocket connection"""
        if user_id in self.users:
            self.users[user_id].online = True
            self.users[user_id].connected_since = datetime.now()
            self.user_sessions[user_id] = websocket
            return True
        return False
    
    def logout_user(self, user_id: str):
        """Log out a user"""
        if user_id in self.users:
            self.users[user_id].online = False
            self.users[user_id].connected_since = None
            self.user_sessions.pop(user_id, None)
            
            # Remove from active projects
            for project_id, users in self.active_projects.items():
                if user_id in users:
                    users.remove(user_id)
    
    # Project management
    def create_project(self, name: str, description: str, created_by: str) -> Project:
        """Create a new project"""
        project_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        project = Project(
            id=project_id,
            name=name,
            description=description,
            created_by=created_by,
            created_at=datetime.now()
        )
        
        # Add creator as collaborator
        project.collaborators.append(created_by)
        
        self.projects[project_id] = project
        self.active_projects[project_id] = []
        return project
    
    def join_project(self, project_id: str, user_id: str) -> bool:
        """Join a user to a project"""
        if project_id in self.projects and user_id in self.users:
            if user_id not in self.projects[project_id].collaborators:
                self.projects[project_id].collaborators.append(user_id)
            
            if user_id not in self.active_projects[project_id]:
                self.active_projects[project_id].append(user_id)
            
            # Notify other users
            self._broadcast_project_update(project_id, f"User {self.users[user_id].username} joined the project")
            return True
        return False
    
    def leave_project(self, project_id: str, user_id: str):
        """Remove a user from a project"""
        if project_id in self.active_projects and user_id in self.active_projects[project_id]:
            self.active_projects[project_id].remove(user_id)
            self._broadcast_project_update(project_id, f"User {self.users[user_id].username} left the project")
    
    # Composition editing
    def add_musical_element(self, project_id: str, user_id: str, element_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[MusicalElement]:
        """Add a musical element to the composition"""
        if project_id not in self.projects or user_id not in self.projects[project_id].collaborators:
            return None
        
        element = MusicalElement(
            id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
            type=element_data.get("type", "note"),
            value=element_data.get("value", "C4"),
            duration=element_data.get("duration", 1.0),
            position=element_data.get("position", 0.0),
            instrument=element_data.get("instrument", "piano"),
            velocity=element_data.get("velocity", 80)
        )
        
        if self.projects[project_id].current_version:
            self.projects[project_id].current_version.musical_elements.append(element)
        
        # Broadcast update
        self._broadcast_composition_update(project_id, {
            "type": "musical_element_added",
            "element": element.to_dict(),
            "user_id": user_id
        })
        
        return element
    
    def add_lyrics(self, project_id: str, user_id: str, text: str, position: float, duration: float) -> Optional[Lyrics]:
        """Add lyrics to the composition"""
        if project_id not in self.projects or user_id not in self.projects[project_id].collaborators:
            return None
        
        lyrics = Lyrics(
            id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
            text=text,
            position=position,
            duration=duration,
            author_id=user_id,
            created_at=datetime.now(),
            sentiment_analysis=SentimentAnalyzer.analyze(text)
        )
        
        if self.projects[project_id].current_version:
            self.projects[project_id].current_version.lyrics.append(lyrics)
        
        # Broadcast update
        self._broadcast_composition_update(project_id, {

class MIDIProcessor:
    """Handles MIDI file processing and conversion."""
    
    @staticmethod
    def parse_midi_file(midi_data):
        """Parse MIDI file data and extract note events."""
        try:
            # Create a MIDI file from bytes
            midi_file = MidiFile(file=io.BytesIO(midi_data))
            note_events = []
            
            for track in midi_file.tracks:
                for msg in track:
                    if msg.type == 'note_on' and msg.velocity > 0:
                        note_events.append({
                            'type': 'note_on',
                            'note': msg.note,
                            'velocity': msg.velocity,
                            'time': msg.time,
                            'channel': msg.channel
                        })
                    elif msg.type == 'note_off' or (msg.type == 'note_on' and msg.velocity == 0):
                        note_events.append({
                            'type': 'note_off',
                            'note': msg.note,
                            'time': msg.time,
                            'channel': msg.channel
                        })
            
            return note_events
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error parsing MIDI file: {e}")
            return []
    
    @staticmethod
    def create_midi_from_notes(note_events, tempo=120):
        """Create a MIDI file from note events."""
        midi_file = MidiFile()
        track = MidiTrack()
        midi_file.tracks.append(track)
        
        # Set tempo
        track.append(mido.MetaMessage('set_tempo', tempo=mido.bpm2tempo(tempo)))
        
        # Add note events
        for event in note_events:
            if event['type'] == 'note_on':
                msg = Message('note_on', 
                            note=event['note'],
                            velocity=event.get('velocity', 64),
                            time=event.get('time', 0))
                track.append(msg)
            elif event['type'] == 'note_off':
                msg = Message('note_off',
                            note=event['note'],
                            velocity=0,
                            time=event.get('time', 0))
                track.append(msg)
        
        # Save to bytes
        midi_bytes = io.BytesIO()
        midi_file.save(file=midi_bytes)
        midi_bytes.seek(0)
        
        return midi_bytes.getvalue()

class MusicProcessingEngine:
    """Engine for processing audio and MIDI data"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def analyze_audio_file(file_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Analyze audio file to extract musical features
        
        Args:
            file_path: Path to audio file
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary containing audio analysis results
        """
        try:
            # Load audio file
            y, sr = librosa.load(file_path, sr=Config.SAMPLE_RATE)
            
            # Extract features
            duration = librosa.get_duration(y=y, sr=sr)
            
            # Get amplitude for waveform visualization
            time_points = np.linspace(0, duration, len(y))
            amplitude = y.tolist()
            
            # Compute spectrogram
            spectrogram = np.abs(librosa.stft(y))
            spectrogram_db = librosa.amplitude_to_db(spectrogram, ref=np.max)
            
            # Compute MFCCs (Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients)
            mfcc = librosa.feature.mfcc(y=y, sr=sr, n_mfcc=13)
            
            # Estimate tempo
            tempo, _ = librosa.beat.beat_track(y=y, sr=sr)
            
            # Detect onsets
            onset_frames = librosa.onset.onset_detect(y=y, sr=sr)
            onset_times = librosa.frames_to_time(onset_frames, sr=sr)
            
            # Extract chroma features for chord analysis
            chroma = librosa.feature.chroma_cqt(y=y, sr=sr)
            
            return {
                "duration": float(duration),
                "sample_rate": sr,
                "time_points": time_points.tolist(),
                "amplitude": amplitude,
                "spectrogram": spectrogram_db.tolist(),
                "mfcc": mfcc.tolist(),
                "tempo": float(tempo[0]) if len(tempo) > 0 else 120.0,
                "onset_times": onset_times.tolist(),
                "chroma": chroma.tolist()
            }
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Error analyzing audio file: {e}")
            raise

        """

        """

                    progression=[],

                )
            
            # Simple chord detection based on chroma peaks
            chords = []
            confidence = []
            
            # Analyze each time frame
            for i in range(min(4, chroma.shape[1])):  # First 4 frames
                frame = chroma[:, i]
                chord_idx = np.argmax(frame)
                
                # Map chroma index to chord
                chord_names = ["C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F",

                chord = chord_names[chord_idx]
                chords.append(chord)
                confidence.append(float(frame[chord_idx]))
            
            # Create progression analysis

            for i, chord in enumerate(chords):

import json

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Set, Tuple

# ==================== Data Models ====================

class NewsCategory(Enum):

class NLPService(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for NLP services."""
    
    @abstractmethod
    def summarize_article(self, content: str, max_length: int = 150) -> str:
        """Generate a summary of the article content."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def categorize_article(self, content: str) -> NewsCategory:
        """Categorize article into appropriate news category."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def analyze_sentiment(self, content: str) -> float:
        """Analyze sentiment of article content (-1 to 1)."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def extract_keywords(self, content: str, num_keywords: int = 5) -> List[str]:
        """Extract keywords from article content."""
        pass


class BasicNLPService(NLPService):
    """
    Basic NLP service implementation.
    In a production system, this would use libraries like spaCy, NLTK, or transformers.
    """
    
    # Mock category detection based on keywords
    _CATEGORY_KEYWORDS = {
        NewsCategory.POLITICS: ['government', 'election', 'policy', 'senate', 'president'],
        NewsCategory.TECHNOLOGY: ['technology', 'software', 'ai', 'computer', 'digital'],
        NewsCategory.HEALTH: ['health', 'medical', 'hospital', 'disease', 'vaccine'],
        NewsCategory.SCIENCE: ['science', 'research', 'study', 'discovery', 'scientist'],
        NewsCategory.BUSINESS: ['business', 'market', 'economy', 'company', 'stock'],
        NewsCategory.ENTERTAINMENT: ['movie', 'celebrity', 'music', 'entertainment', 'show'],
        NewsCategory.SPORTS: ['sports', 'game', 'team', 'player', 'championship'],
        NewsCategory.WORLD: ['world', 'international', 'global', 'country', 'nation']
    }
    
    def summarize_article(self, content: str, max_length: int = 150) -> str:
        """Generate a simple summary by taking the first few sentences."""
        sentences = content.split('. ')
        summary = '. '.join(sentences[:2])
        if len(summary) > max_length:
            summary = summary[:max_length] + '...'
        return summary
    
    def categorize_article(self, content: str) -> NewsCategory:
        """Categorize article based on keyword matching."""
        content_lower = content.lower()
        scores = {}
        
        for category, keywords in self._CATEGORY_KEYWORDS.items():
            score = sum(1 for keyword in keywords if keyword in content_lower)
            scores[category] = score
        
        # Return category with highest score, default to POLITICS
        return max(scores.items(), key=lambda x: x[1])[0] if scores else NewsCategory.POLITICS
    
    def analyze_sentiment(self, content: str) -> float:
        """Basic sentiment analysis based on positive/negative word counts."""
        positive_words = {'good', 'great', 'excellent', 'positive', 'success', 'win', 'happy'}
        negative_words = {'bad', 'poor', 'negative', 'failure', 'lose', 'sad', 'terrible'}
        
        words = content.lower().split()
        pos_count = sum(1 for word in words if word in positive_words)
        neg_count = sum(1 for word in words if word in negative_words)
        
        total = pos_count + neg_count
        if total == 0:
            return 0.0
        
        # Normalize to -1 to 1 range
        return (pos_count - neg_count) / total
    
    def extract_keywords(self, content: str, num_keywords: int = 5) -> List[str]:
        """Extract most frequent words (excluding common stop words)."""
        stop_words = {'the', 'and', 'a', 'an', 'in', 'on', 'at', 'to', 'for', 'of', 'with', 'by'}
        words = [word.lower() for word in content.split() if word.isalpha()]
        words = [word for word in words if word not in stop_words]
        
        # Get most common words
        word_counts = Counter(words)
        return [word for word, _ in word_counts.most_common(num_keywords)]

class RecommendationEngine:
    """
    Engine for generating personalized news recommendations.
    Uses collaborative filtering and content-based filtering.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.user_profiles: Dict[str, Dict] = {}
        self.article_profiles: Dict[str, Dict] = {}
    
    def update_user_profile(self, user: User):
        """Update user profile based on interactions."""
        profile = {
            'interests': [cat.value for cat in user.interests],
            'click_history': user.click_history[-100:],  # Last 100 clicks
            'saved_articles': list(user.saved_articles),
            'feedback_scores': self._calculate_feedback_scores(user.feedback_history)
        }
        self.user_profiles[user.user_id] = profile
    
    def update_article_profile(self, article: Article):
        """Create/update article profile."""
        profile = {
            'category': article.category.value,
            'keywords': article.keywords,
            'sentiment': article.sentiment_score or 0.0,
            'popularity': 0  # Will be updated based on interactions
        }
        self.article_profiles[article.article_id] = profile
    
    def generate_recommendations(self, user: User, articles: List[Article], 
                                 num_recommendations: int = 10) -> List[Article]:
        """Generate personalized recommendations for a user."""
        if not articles:
            return []
        
        # Update user profile
        self.update_user_profile(user)
        
        # Score articles based on multiple factors
        scored_articles = []
        for article in articles:
            score = self._calculate_article_score(user, article)
            scored_articles.append((article, score))
        
        # Sort by score and return top recommendations
        scored_articles.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
        return [article for article, _ in scored_articles[:num_recommendations]]
    
    def _calculate_article_score(self, user: User, article: Article) -> float:
        """Calculate recommendation score for an article."""
        score = 0.0
        
        # Interest match
        if article.category in user.interests:
            score += 2.0
        
        # Click history similarity
        if user.click_history:
            recent_clicks = user.click_history[-10:]
            # Simulate collaborative filtering (in real system would use proper algorithm)
            if any(click_id in self.article_profiles for click_id in recent_clicks):
                score += 1.0
        
        # Saved articles similarity
        if article.article_id in user.saved_articles:
            score += 3.0
        
        # Freshness
        days_old = (datetime.datetime.now() - article.publish_date).days
        if days_old < 1:
            score += 2.0
        elif days_old < 7:
            score += 1.0
        
        # Add some randomness for exploration
        score += random.uniform(0, 0.5)
        
        return score
    
    def _calculate_feedback_scores(self, feedback_history: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """Calculate average feedback scores from user history."""
        if not feedback_history:
            return {'relevance': 0.5, 'accuracy': 0.5}
        
        relevance_scores = [fb['relevance_score'] for fb in feedback_history]
        accuracy_scores = [fb['accuracy_score'] for fb in feedback_history]
        
        return {
            'relevance': sum(relevance_scores) / len(relevance_scores),
            'accuracy': sum(accuracy_scores) / len(accuracy_scores)
        }

    def _preprocess_text(self, text: str) -> List[str]:
        """Clean and tokenize text."""
        # Convert to lowercase
        text = text.lower()
        # Remove special characters and numbers
        text = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z\s]', '', text)
        # Tokenize
        tokens = text.split()
        # Remove stopwords (basic list)
        stopwords = {'the', 'a', 'an', 'and', 'or', 'but', 'in', 'on', 'at', 'to', 'for',

    def _compute_idf_values(self):
        """Compute IDF values for topic vocabulary."""
        # Collect all unique words across topics

        for words in self.topic_vocab.values():
            all_words.update(words)
        
        # Calculate document frequency (number of topics containing each word)
        doc_freq = {}
        for word in all_words:
            freq = 0
            for topic_words in self.topic_vocab.values():

                    set_i = set(processed_sentences[i])
                    set_j = set(processed_sentences[j])

        scores = np.ones(n) / n
        damping = 0.85

class AnalyticsEngine:
    """Engine for news analytics and insights"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def calculate_popularity_trends(articles: List[NewsArticle], 
                                   interactions: List[UserInteraction]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Calculate popularity trends for articles"""
        article_interactions = defaultdict(list)
        
        for interaction in interactions:
            article_interactions[interaction.article_id].append(interaction)
        
        trends = {
            'most_popular': [],
            'trending_topics': defaultdict(int),
            'sentiment_distribution': defaultdict(int)
        }
        
        for article in articles:
            interactions_count = len(article_interactions.get(article.id, []))
            popularity_score = interactions_count * 1.0
            
            # Update article popularity
            article.popularity_score = popularity_score
            
            if interactions_count > 0:
                trends['most_popular'].append({
                    'article_id': article.id,
                    'title': article.title,
                    'interactions': interactions_count,
                    'popularity_score': popularity_score
                })
            
            # Track topic popularity
            for topic in article.topics:
                trends['trending_topics'][topic.value] += interactions_count
            
            # Track sentiment distribution
            if article.sentiment:
                trends['sentiment_distribution'][article.sentiment.value] += interactions_count
        
        # Sort most popular articles
        trends['most_popular'].sort(key=lambda x: x['popularity_score'], reverse=True)
        
        # Sort trending topics
        trends['trending_topics'] = dict(sorted(
            trends['trending_topics'].items(), 
            key=lambda x: x[1], 
            reverse=True
        ))
        
        return trends
    
    @staticmethod
    def identify_emerging_topics(articles: List[NewsArticle], 
                                time_window_hours: int = 24) -> List[Tuple[Topic, int]]:
        """Identify emerging topics based on recent articles"""
        cutoff_time = datetime.datetime.now() - datetime.timedelta(hours=time_window_hours)
        
        recent_articles = [
            article for article in articles 
            if article.published_at > cutoff_time
        ]
        
        topic_counts = defaultdict(int)
        for article in recent_articles:
            for topic in article.topics:
                topic_counts[topic] += 1
        
        # Return topics sorted by frequency in recent articles
        return sorted(topic_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)

        self.articles = self.recommendation_engine.recommend_articles(
            self.user_id, available_articles
        )
        self.current_index = 0
    
    def get_next_articles(self, count: int = 5) -> List[NewsArticle]:
        """Get next batch of articles from the feed"""
        start = self.current_index
        end = min(start + count, len(self.articles))
        
        if start >= len(self.articles):
            return []
        
        articles = self.articles[start:end]
        self.current_index = end
        
        return articles
    
    def reset_feed(self) -> None:
        """Reset feed to beginning"""
        self.current_index = 0

        for interaction in interactions:

        trends = {

                trends['most_popular'].append({

                    'title': article.title,
                    'interactions': interactions_count,
                    'popularity_score': popularity_score
                })
            
            # Track topic popularity
            for topic in article.topics:
                trends['trending_topics'][topic.value] += interactions_count
            
            # Track sentiment distribution
            if article.sentiment:
                trends['sentiment_distribution'][article.sentiment.value] += interactions_count

        trends['most_popular'].sort(key=lambda x: x['popularity_score'], reverse=True)

    return pwd_context.verify(plain_password, hashed_password)

    return pwd_context.hash(password)


def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None):
    """Create JWT access token"""
    to_encode = data.copy()
    if expires_delta:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + expires_delta
    else:
        expire = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    to_encode.update({"exp": expire})
    encoded_jwt = jwt.encode(to_encode, SECRET_KEY, algorithm=ALGORITHM)
    return encoded_jwt


def verify_token(credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security)):
    """Verify JWT token"""
    token = credentials.credentials
    try:

    except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError:
        raise HTTPException(

            detail="Token has expired",

# ==================== Collaboration Manager ====================
class CollaborationManager:
    """Manages collaboration between AI agents for news analysis."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.agents: Dict[str, AIAgent] = {}
        self.agent_insights: Dict[str, List[str]] = defaultdict(list)
        self.article_summaries: Dict[str, List[NewsSummary]] = defaultdict(list)
        logger.info("Initialized Collaboration Manager")
    
    def register_agent(self, agent: AIAgent):
        """Register an AI agent with the collaboration manager."""
        self.agents[agent.agent_id] = agent
        logger.info(f"Registered agent: {agent.agent_id}")
    
    async def analyze_article_with_agents(self, article: NewsArticle) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Collaborate with multiple agents to analyze an article.
        Returns combined insights and a consensus summary.
        """
        logger.info(f"Collaborative analysis of article: {article.id}")
        
        tasks = []
        for agent in self.agents.values():
            tasks.append(agent.analyze_article(article))
            tasks.append(agent.provide_insights(article))
        
        # Execute all agent analyses concurrently
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        
        # Process results
        summaries = []
        all_insights = []
        
        for i, result in enumerate(results):
            if isinstance(result, Exception):
                logger.error(f"Agent analysis failed: {result}")
                continue
            
            agent_index = i // 2
            agent = list(self.agents.values())[agent_index]
            
            if i % 2 == 0:  # Summary result
                if isinstance(result, NewsSummary):
                    summaries.append(result)
                    self.article_summaries[article.id].append(result)
            else:  # Insights result
                if isinstance(result, list):
                    all_insights.extend(result)
                    self.agent_insights[article.id].extend(result)
        
        # Generate consensus summary weighted by agent performance
        consensus_summary = self._generate_consensus_summary(summaries, article)
        
        return {
            "article_id": article.id,
            "consensus_summary": consensus_summary,
            "individual_summaries": summaries,
            "insights": all_insights,
            "analyzed_by": [s.agent_id for s in summaries]
        }
    
    def _generate_consensus_summary(self, summaries: List[NewsSummary], article: NewsArticle) -> str:
        """Generate a consensus summary from multiple agent summaries."""
        if not summaries:
            return f"No analysis available for article: {article.title}"
        
        # Weight summaries by agent confidence and performance
        weighted_summaries = []
        for summary in summaries:
            agent = self.agents.get(summary.agent_id)
            weight = agent.weight if agent else 1.0
            weighted_importance = summary.confidence_score * weight
            weighted_summaries.append((summary.summary, weighted_importance))
        
        # Select the highest weighted summary as consensus
        if weighted_summaries:
            best_summary = max(weighted_summaries, key=lambda x: x[1])[0]
            return f"Consensus Analysis: {best_summary}"
        
        return summaries[0].summary
    
    def update_agent_weights_based_on_feedback(self, feedback: UserFeedback):
        """Update agent weights based on user feedback."""
        avg_score = (feedback.relevance_score + feedback.quality_score) / 2
        
        for agent in self.agents.values():
            agent.adjust_weight_based_on_feedback(avg_score)
        
        logger.info(f"Updated agent weights based on feedback from user {feedback.user_id}")

    """Curates news items based on collaborative analysis and user preferences."""
    
    def __init__(self, collaboration_manager: CollaborationManager):

import asyncio

# ============================================

class NewsSourceType(Enum):
    """Enumeration of supported news source types."""
    RSS = "rss"
    NEWS_API = "news_api"
    SOCIAL_MEDIA = "social_media"
    WEB_SCRAPE = "web_scrape"


@dataclass
class NewsArticle:
    """Data model for a news article."""
    id: str
    title: str
    content: str
    source: str
    source_type: NewsSourceType
    url: str
    published_at: datetime
    categories: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    authors: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    raw_data: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Convert article to dictionary for serialization."""
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "title": self.title,
            "content": self.content,
            "source": self.source,
            "source_type": self.source_type.value,
            "url": self.url,
            "published_at": self.published_at.isoformat(),
            "categories": self.categories,
            "authors": self.authors
        }


@dataclass
class AnalysisResult:
    """Data model for AI agent analysis results."""
    article_id: str
    agent_id: str
    summary: str
    key_insights: List[str]
    annotations: Dict[str, str]
    relevance_score: float  # 0.0 to 1.0
    confidence: float  # 0.0 to 1.0
    timestamp: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Convert analysis result to dictionary."""
        return {
            "article_id": self.article_id,
            "agent_id": self.agent_id,
            "summary": self.summary,
            "key_insights": self.key_insights,
            "annotations": self.annotations,
            "relevance_score": self.relevance_score,
            "confidence": self.confidence,
            "timestamp": self.timestamp.isoformat()
        }


@dataclass
class CuratedNewsItem:
    """Data model for curated news items displayed to users."""
    id: str
    article: NewsArticle
    combined_summary: str
    aggregated_insights: List[str]
    overall_relevance: float
    contributing_agents: List[str]
    curation_time: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
    user_ratings: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # user_id -> rating
    average_rating: float = 0.0

    def update_rating(self, user_id: str, rating: float) -> None:
        """Update user rating and recalculate average."""
        self.user_ratings[user_id] = rating
        if self.user_ratings:
            self.average_rating = sum(self.user_ratings.values()) / len(self.user_ratings)


@dataclass
class UserProfile:
    """Data model for user profiles and preferences."""
    user_id: str
    preferred_categories: Set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    preferred_sources: Set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    interaction_history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    feedback_history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
    last_active: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)

    def add_interaction(self, item_id: str, action: str) -> None:
        """Record user interaction."""
        self.interaction_history.append({
            "item_id": item_id,
            "action": action,
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
        })
        self.last_active = datetime.now()

    def add_feedback(self, item_id: str, rating: float, comments: str = "") -> None:
        """Record user feedback."""
        self.feedback_history.append({
            "item_id": item_id,
            "rating": rating,
            "comments": comments,
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
        })


# ============================================
# Abstract Base Classes and Interfaces
# ============================================

class NewsFetcher(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for news fetchers from different sources."""
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def fetch_articles(self, max_articles: int = 10) -> List[NewsArticle]:
        """Fetch articles from the source."""
        pass


class AIAgent(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for AI agents."""
    
    def __init__(self, agent_id: str, name: str, capabilities: List[str]):
        self.agent_id = agent_id
        self.name = name
        self.capabilities = capabilities
        self.weight: float = 1.0  # Dynamic weight based on performance
        self.performance_history: List[float] = []
        logger.info(f"Initialized AI Agent: {name} (ID: {agent_id})")
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def analyze_article(self, article: NewsArticle) -> AnalysisResult:
        """Analyze a news article and return insights."""
        pass
    
    def update_weight(self, feedback_score: float) -> None:
        """Update agent weight based on feedback."""
        self.performance_history.append(feedback_score)
        # Simple moving average for weight calculation
        if len(self.performance_history) > 10:
            self.performance_history = self.performance_history[-10:]
        
        avg_performance = sum(self.performance_history) / len(self.performance_history)
        self.weight = max(0.1, min(2.0, avg_performance))
        logger.info(f"Updated weight for agent {self.name}: {self.weight}")


class CollaborationManager:
    """Manages collaboration between AI agents."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.agents: Dict[str, AIAgent] = {}
        self.shared_insights: Dict[str, List[AnalysisResult]] = {}
        self.collaboration_history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    
    def register_agent(self, agent: AIAgent) -> None:
        """Register an AI agent with the collaboration manager."""
        self.agents[agent.agent_id] = agent
        self.shared_insights[agent.agent_id] = []
        logger.info(f"Registered agent: {agent.name}")
    
    async def analyze_with_collaboration(self, article: NewsArticle) -> List[AnalysisResult]:
        """Analyze article with all registered agents."""
        tasks = []
        for agent in self.agents.values():
            task = asyncio.create_task(agent.analyze_article(article))
            tasks.append(task)
        
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        
        valid_results = []
        for agent, result in zip(self.agents.values(), results):
            if isinstance(result, Exception):
                logger.error(f"Agent {agent.name} failed to analyze article: {result}")
                continue
            
            valid_results.append(result)
            self.shared_insights[agent.agent_id].append(result)
        
        # Record collaboration
        self.collaboration_history.append({
            "article_id": article.id,
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "participating_agents": [agent.agent_id for agent in self.agents.values()],
            "results_count": len(valid_results)
        })
        
        return valid_results
    
    def get_agent_insights(self, agent_id: str, limit: int = 10) -> List[AnalysisResult]:
        """Get recent insights from a specific agent."""
        return self.shared_insights.get(agent_id, [])[-limit:]

class NewsFetcher(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for news fetchers from different sources."""
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def fetch_articles(self, max_articles: int = 10) -> List[NewsArticle]:
        """Fetch articles from the source."""
        pass


class AIAgent(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for AI agents."""
    
    def __init__(self, agent_id: str, name: str, capabilities: List[str]):
        self.agent_id = agent_id
        self.name = name
        self.capabilities = capabilities
        self.weight: float = 1.0  # Dynamic weight based on performance
        self.performance_history: List[float] = []
        logger.info(f"Initialized AI Agent: {name} (ID: {agent_id})")
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def analyze_article(self, article: NewsArticle) -> AnalysisResult:
        """Analyze a news article and return insights."""
        pass
    
    def update_weight(self, feedback_score: float) -> None:
        """Update agent weight based on feedback."""
        self.performance_history.append(feedback_score)
        # Simple moving average for weight calculation
        if len(self.performance_history) > 10:
            self.performance_history = self.performance_history[-10:]
        
        avg_performance = sum(self.performance_history) / len(self.performance_history)
        self.weight = max(0.1, min(2.0, avg_performance))
        logger.info(f"Updated weight for agent {self.name}: {self.weight}")


class CollaborationManager:
    """Manages collaboration between AI agents."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.agents: Dict[str, AIAgent] = {}
        self.shared_insights: Dict[str, List[AnalysisResult]] = {}
        self.collaboration_history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    
    def register_agent(self, agent: AIAgent) -> None:
        """Register an AI agent with the collaboration manager."""
        self.agents[agent.agent_id] = agent
        self.shared_insights[agent.agent_id] = []
        logger.info(f"Registered agent: {agent.name}")
    
    async def analyze_with_collaboration(self, article: NewsArticle) -> List[AnalysisResult]:
        """Analyze article with all registered agents."""
        tasks = []
        for agent in self.agents.values():
            task = asyncio.create_task(agent.analyze_article(article))
            tasks.append(task)
        
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        
        valid_results = []
        for agent, result in zip(self.agents.values(), results):
            if isinstance(result, Exception):
                logger.error(f"Agent {agent.name} failed to analyze article: {result}")
                continue
            
            valid_results.append(result)
            self.shared_insights[agent.agent_id].append(result)
        
        # Record collaboration
        self.collaboration_history.append({
            "article_id": article.id,
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "participating_agents": [agent.agent_id for agent in self.agents.values()],
            "results_count": len(valid_results)
        })
        
        return valid_results
    
    def get_agent_insights(self, agent_id: str, limit: int = 10) -> List[AnalysisResult]:
        """Get recent insights from a specific agent."""
        return self.shared_insights.get(agent_id, [])[-limit:]

            suggestions.extend(["#FFFF00", "#FF00FF", "#00FFFF"])
        elif context.get("drawing_style") == DrawingStyle.TECHNICAL:
            # Standard technical drawing colors
            suggestions.extend(["#808080", "#A52A2A", "#000080"])
        
        # Remove duplicates while preserving order
        seen = set()
        unique_suggestions = []
        for color in suggestions:

        if context.get("recent_activity") == "annotating":

            suggestions.append(ToolType.HIGHLIGHTER)
        elif context.get("recent_activity") == "drawing_shapes":
            suggestions.append(ToolType.SHAPE)
        
        # Remove duplicates while preserving order
        seen = set()
        unique_suggestions = []
        for tool in suggestions:
            if tool not in seen:
                seen.add(tool)
                unique_suggestions.append(tool)
        
        return unique_suggestions
    
    @staticmethod

        """
        Provide real-time feedback on drawing accuracy and style.
        
        Args:

            Dictionary containing feedback metrics
        """
        feedback = {
            "smoothness": 0.0,
            "consistency": 0.0,
            "style_match": 0.0,
            "suggestions": []
        }
        
        # Calculate smoothness based on point distances
        if len(stroke.points) > 2:
            distances = []
            for i in range(1, len(stroke.points)):
                x1, y1 = stroke.points[i-1]

class NotebookManager:
    """Manages the notebook including pages, users, and collaboration."""
    
    def __init__(self, notebook_id: str, title: str):
        """
        Initialize a new notebook.
        
        Args:
            notebook_id: Unique identifier for the notebook
            title: Title of the notebook
        """
        self.notebook_id = notebook_id
        self.title = title
        self.pages: Dict[str, Page] = {}
        self.users: Dict[str, User] = {}
        self.page_history: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}  # Page ID -> List of versions
        self.active_users: Set[str] = set()  # Users currently online
        self.created_at = datetime.datetime.now()
    
    def add_user(self, user: User) -> bool:
        """
        Add a user to the notebook.
        
        Args:
            user: The user to add
            
        Returns:
            True if user was added successfully, False otherwise
        """
        if user.user_id in self.users:
            return False
        
        self.users[user.user_id] = user
        return True
    
    def create_page(self, title: str, user_id: str) -> Optional[Page]:
        """
        Create a new page in the notebook.
        
        Args:
            title: Title of the new page
            user_id: ID of the user creating the page
            
        Returns:
            The created Page object, or None if user doesn't have permission
        """
        if user_id not in self.users:
            return None
        
        user = self.users[user_id]
        if user.role == UserRole.VIEWER:
            return None
        
        page_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        page = Page(page_id=page_id, title=title)
        self.pages[page_id] = page
        self.page_history[page_id] = [page.to_dict()]
        
        return page
    
    def add_stroke(self, page_id: str, stroke: Stroke) -> bool:
        """
        Add a stroke to a page.
        
        Args:
            page_id: ID of the page to add the stroke to
            stroke: The stroke to add
            
        Returns:
            True if stroke was added successfully, False otherwise
        """
        if page_id not in self.pages:
            return False
        
        page = self.pages[page_id]
        page.strokes.append(stroke)
        page.last_modified = datetime.datetime.now()
        
        # Save to history (simplified - in production would save diffs)
        self._save_to_history(page_id)
        
        return True
    
    def add_comment(self, page_id: str, comment: Comment) -> bool:
        """
        Add a comment to a page.
        
        Args:
            page_id: ID of the page to add the comment to
            comment: The comment to add
            
        Returns:
            True if comment was added successfully, False otherwise
        """
        if page_id not in self.pages:
            return False
        
        page = self.pages[page_id]
        page.comments.append(comment)
        page.last_modified = datetime.datetime.now()
        
        # Save to history
        self._save_to_history(page_id)
        
        return True
    
    def get_page_version(self, page_id: str, version_index: int) -> Optional[Page]:
        """
        Get a specific version of a page from history.
        
        Args:
            page_id: ID of the page
            version_index: Index of the version to retrieve (0 = oldest)
            
        Returns:
            The Page object at the specified version, or None if not found
        """
        if page_id not in self.page_history:
            return None
        
        history = self.page_history[page_id]
        if version_index < 0 or version_index >= len(history):
            return None
        
        return Page.from_dict(history[version_index])
    
    def revert_page(self, page_id: str, version_index: int, user_id: str) -> bool:
        """
        Revert a page to a previous version.
        
        Args:
            page_id: ID of the page to revert
            version_index: Index of the version to revert to
            user_id: ID of the user requesting the revert
            
        Returns:
            True if reversion was successful, False otherwise
        """
        if user_id not in self.users or self.users[user_id].role == UserRole.VIEWER:
            return False
        
        old_page = self.get_page_version(page_id, version_index)
        if not old_page:
            return False
        
        self.pages[page_id] = old_page
        self._save_to_history(page_id)
        
        return True
    
    def _save_to_history(self, page_id: str) -> None:
        """Save current page state to history."""
        if page_id in self.pages:
            page_dict = self.pages[page_id].to_dict()
            self.page_history[page_id].append(page_dict)
            
            # Keep only last 50 versions (configurable)
            if len(self.page_history[page_id]) > 50:
                self.page_history[page_id] = self.page_history[page_id][-50:]
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Convert NotebookManager object to dictionary for serialization."""
        return {
            "notebook_id": self.notebook_id,
            "title": self.title,
            "pages": {page_id: page.to_dict() for page_id, page in self.pages.items()},
            "users": {user_id: user.to_dict() for user_id, user in self.users.items()},
            "page_history": self.page_history,
            "created_at": self.created_at.isoformat()
        }
    
    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> 'NotebookManager':
        """Create NotebookManager object from dictionary."""
        notebook = cls(
            notebook_id=data["notebook_id"],
            title=data["title"]
        )
        notebook.created_at = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(data["created_at"])

        # Load pages

            notebook.pages[page_id] = Page.from_dict(page_data)
        
        # Load history
        notebook.page_history = data.get("page_history", {})
        
        return notebook

class DataManager:
    """Manages datasets and their metadata."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.datasets: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame] = {}
        self.metadata: Dict[str, DatasetMetadata] = {}
        self.profiles: Dict[str, DataProfile] = {}
        self.version_history: List[VersionHistory] = []
        
    def import_dataset(self, filepath: str, format: DataFormat, dataset_id: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
        """
        Import a dataset from file.
        
        Args:
            filepath: Path to the data file
            format: Format of the data file
            dataset_id: Optional ID for the dataset
            
        Returns:
            Dataset ID
        """
        if dataset_id is None:
            dataset_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
            
        try:
            if format == DataFormat.CSV:
                df = pd.read_csv(filepath)
            elif format == DataFormat.EXCEL:
                df = pd.read_excel(filepath)
            elif format == DataFormat.JSON:
                df = pd.read_json(filepath)
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported format: {format}")
            
            # Store dataset
            self.datasets[dataset_id] = df
            
            # Create metadata
            missing_values = df.isnull().sum().to_dict()
            data_types = df.dtypes.astype(str).to_dict()
            
            metadata = DatasetMetadata(
                dataset_id=dataset_id,
                filename=filepath,
                format=format,
                columns=list(df.columns),
                row_count=len(df),
                column_count=len(df.columns),
                import_timestamp=datetime.datetime.now(),
                missing_values=missing_values,
                data_types=data_types
            )
            self.metadata[dataset_id] = metadata
            
            # Create initial profile
            self._create_profile(dataset_id)
            
            # Record version history
            self._record_version(
                dataset_id=dataset_id,
                user_id="system",
                change_type="import",
                change_description=f"Imported dataset from {filepath}"
            )
            
            return dataset_id
            
        except Exception as e:
            raise Exception(f"Failed to import dataset: {str(e)}")
    
    def _create_profile(self, dataset_id: str) -> DataProfile:
        """Create data profile for a dataset."""
        df = self.datasets[dataset_id]
        
        # Summary statistics

        summary_stats = {}
        for col in numeric_cols:
            summary_stats[col] = {

class AdaptiveFeatureEngine:
    """Engine for adaptive features based on user interactions."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.user_patterns: Dict[str, Dict] = defaultdict(dict)
        self.color_suggestions: List[str] = [
            "#FF0000", "#00FF00", "#0000FF", "#FFFF00", "#FF00FF", "#00FFFF",
            "#FFA500", "#800080", "#008000", "#FFC0CB", "#A52A2A", "#FFFFFF"
        ]
        self.tool_suggestions: List[DrawingTool] = [
            DrawingTool.BRUSH, DrawingTool.PEN, DrawingTool.MARKER,
            DrawingTool.HIGHLIGHTER, DrawingTool.SHAPE
        ]
    
    def analyze_user_pattern(self, user_id: str, tool: DrawingTool, color: str) -> None:
        """Analyze and store user's tool and color usage patterns."""
        if user_id not in self.user_patterns:
            self.user_patterns[user_id] = {
                "tool_frequency": defaultdict(int),
                "color_frequency": defaultdict(int),
                "last_used": {}
            }
        
        patterns = self.user_patterns[user_id]
        patterns["tool_frequency"][tool] += 1
        patterns["color_frequency"][color] += 1
        patterns["last_used"] = {"tool": tool, "color": color}
    
    def get_suggested_tools(self, user_id: str) -> List[DrawingTool]:
        """Get suggested tools based on user's past usage patterns."""
        if user_id not in self.user_patterns:
            return self.tool_suggestions
        
        patterns = self.user_patterns[user_id]
        tool_freq = patterns["tool_frequency"]
        
        if not tool_freq:
            return self.tool_suggestions
        
        # Sort tools by frequency (most used first)
        sorted_tools = sorted(tool_freq.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
        suggested = [tool for tool, _ in sorted_tools[:3]]
        
        # Add some variety
        for tool in self.tool_suggestions:
            if tool not in suggested and len(suggested) < 5:
                suggested.append(tool)
        
        return suggested
    
    def get_suggested_colors(self, user_id: str) -> List[str]:
        """Get suggested colors based on user's past usage patterns."""
        if user_id not in self.user_patterns:
            return self.color_suggestions
        
        patterns = self.user_patterns[user_id]
        color_freq = patterns["color_frequency"]
        
        if not color_freq:
            return self.color_suggestions
        
        # Sort colors by frequency (most used first)
        sorted_colors = sorted(color_freq.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
        suggested = [color for color, _ in sorted_colors[:4]]
        
        # Add complementary colors
        for color in self.color_suggestions:
            if color not in suggested and len(suggested) < 8:
                suggested.append(color)
        
        return suggested
    
    def provide_feedback(self, stroke: Stroke) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Provide real-time feedback on drawing accuracy and style."""
        feedback = {
            "smoothness": self._calculate_smoothness(stroke.points),
            "speed": self._calculate_drawing_speed(stroke),
            "consistency": self._check_consistency(stroke)
        }
        
        # Add suggestions based on analysis
        if feedback["smoothness"] < 0.7:
            feedback["suggestion"] = "Try drawing with smoother strokes for better accuracy"
        elif feedback["speed"] > 1000:  # pixels per second

        users_dict = {username: asdict(user) for username, user in users.items()}
        with open(self.users_file, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(users_dict, f, indent=2)
    
    def load_users(self) -> Dict[str, User]:
        """Load users from JSON file and return as dictionary."""
        with open(self.users_file, 'r') as f:
            users_dict = json.load(f)
        
        users = {}
        for username, user_data in users_dict.items():
            users[username] = User(**user_data)
        return users
    
    def save_tasks(self, tasks: Dict[str, Task]) -> None:
        """Save tasks dictionary to JSON file."""
        tasks_dict = {task_id: task.to_dict() for task_id, task in tasks.items()}
        with open(self.tasks_file, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(tasks_dict, f, indent=2)
    
    def load_tasks(self) -> Dict[str, Task]:
        """Load tasks from JSON file and return as dictionary."""
        with open(self.tasks_file, 'r') as f:
            tasks_dict = json.load(f)
        
        tasks = {}
        for task_id, task_data in tasks_dict.items():
            tasks[task_id] = Task.from_dict(task_data)
        return tasks
    
    def save_notifications(self, notifications: Dict[str, Notification]) -> None:
        """Save notifications dictionary to JSON file."""
        notifications_dict = {
            notif_id: notif.to_dict() 
            for notif_id, notif in notifications.items()
        }
        with open(self.notifications_file, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(notifications_dict, f, indent=2)
    
    def load_notifications(self) -> Dict[str, Notification]:
        """Load notifications from JSON file and return as dictionary."""
        with open(self.notifications_file, 'r') as f:
            notifications_dict = json.load(f)
        
        notifications = {}
        for notif_id, notif_data in notifications_dict.items():
            notifications[notif_id] = Notification.from_dict(notif_data)
        return notifications


class OfficeTaskScheduler:
    """Main task scheduler class implementing business logic."""
    
    def __init__(self, data_storage: DataStorage = None):
        self.data_storage = data_storage or JSONDataStorage()
        self.users = self.data_storage.load_users()
        self.tasks = self.data_storage.load_tasks()
        self.notifications = self.data_storage.load_notifications()
        self.current_user = None
    
    def _generate_id(self, prefix: str) -> str:
        """Generate a unique ID with given prefix."""
        import uuid
        return f"{prefix}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    
    def _save_all_data(self) -> None:
        """Save all data to persistent storage."""
        self.data_storage.save_users(self.users)
        self.data_storage.save_tasks(self.tasks)
        self.data_storage.save_notifications(self.notifications)
    
    def register_user(self, username: str, password: str, role: str = "team_member") -> bool:
        """Register a new user."""
        if username in self.users:
            return False
        
        self.users[username] = User(username=username, password=password, role=role)
        self._save_all_data()
        return True
    
    def login(self, username: str, password: str) -> bool:
        """Authenticate user and set as current user."""
        user = self.users.get(username)
        if user and user.password == password:
            self.current_user = username
            return True
        return False
    
    def logout(self) -> None:
        """Logout current user."""
        self.current_user = None
    
    def create_task(
        self,
        title: str,
        description: str,
        assigned_to: str,
        deadline: datetime,
        priority: PriorityLevel
    ) -> Optional[str]:
        """Create a new task and assign it to a user."""
        if not self.current_user:
            raise PermissionError("User must be logged in to create tasks")
        
        if assigned_to not in self.users:
            raise ValueError(f"User '{assigned_to}' does not exist")
        
        if deadline < datetime.now():
            raise ValueError("Deadline cannot be in the past")
        
        task_id = self._generate_id("task")
        current_time = datetime.now()
        
        task = Task(
            task_id=task_id,
            title=title,
            description=description,
            created_by=self.current_user,
            assigned_to=assigned_to,
            created_at=current_time,
            deadline=deadline,
            priority=priority,
            status=TaskStatus.PENDING,
            comments=[],
            last_updated=current_time
        )
        
        self.tasks[task_id] = task
        
        # Create notification for assigned user
        notification_id = self._generate_id("notif")
        notification = Notification(
            notification_id=notification_id,
            user=assigned_to,
            type=NotificationType.TASK_ASSIGNED,
            message=f"New task '{title}' assigned to you by {self.current_user}",
            task_id=task_id,
            created_at=current_time
        )
        self.notifications[notification_id] = notification
        
        self._save_all_data()
        return task_id
    
    def get_user_tasks(self, username: str = None) -> List[Task]:
        """Get all tasks assigned to a specific user."""
        if not username:
            if not self.current_user:
                raise PermissionError("User must be logged in")
            username = self.current_user
        
        if username != self.current_user and self.users[self.current_user].role != "manager":
            raise PermissionError("Cannot access other users' tasks without manager role")
        
        return [
            task for task in self.tasks.values() 
            if task.assigned_to == username
        ]
    
    def update_task_status(self, task_id: str, status: TaskStatus) -> bool:
        """Update the status of a task."""
        if not self.current_user:
            raise PermissionError("User must be logged in")
        
        task = self.tasks.get(task_id)
        if not task:
            return False
        
        if task.assigned_to != self.current_user and self.users[self.current_user].role != "manager":
            raise PermissionError("Cannot update task assigned to another user")
        
        task.status = status
        task.last_updated = datetime.now()
        
        # Create notification for task creator about status update
        notification_id = self._generate_id("notif")
        notification = Notification(
            notification_id=notification_id,
            user=task.created_by,
            type=NotificationType.STATUS_UPDATED,
            message=f"Task '{task.title}' status updated to {status.value} by {self.current_user}",
            task_id=task_id,
            created_at=datetime.now()
        )
        self.notifications[notification_id] = notification
        
        self._save_all_data()
        return True
    
    def add_task_comment(self, task_id: str, comment: str) -> bool:
        """Add a comment to a task."""
        if not self.current_user:
            raise PermissionError("User must be logged in")
        
        task = self.tasks.get(task_id)
        if not task:
            return False
        
        if task.assigned_to != self.current_user and task.created_by != self.current_user:
            raise PermissionError("Cannot add comment to task you're not assigned to or didn't create")
        
        task.comments.append({
            "user": self.current_user,
            "comment": comment,
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
        })
        task.last_updated = datetime.now()
        
        # Create notification for other involved users
        notification_id = self._generate_id("notif")
        other_user = task.created_by if self.current_user == task.assigned_to else task.assigned_to
        notification = Notification(
            notification_id=notification_id,
            user=other_user,
            type=NotificationType.COMMENT_ADDED,
            message=f"New comment added to task '{task.title}' by {self.current_user}",
            task_id=task_id,
            created_at=datetime.now()
        )
        self.notifications[notification_id] = notification
        
        self._save_all_data()
        return True
    
    def get_user_notifications(self, username: str = None, unread_only: bool = False) -> List[Notification]:
        """Get notifications for a specific user."""
        if not username:
            if not self.current_user:
                raise PermissionError("User must be logged in")
            username = self.current_user
        
        if username != self.current_user:
            raise PermissionError("Cannot access other users' notifications")
        
        user_notifications = [
            notif for notif in self.notifications.values() 
            if notif.user == username
        ]
        
        if unread_only:
            user_notifications = [notif for notif in user_notifications if not notif.is_read]
        
        return sorted(user_notifications, key=lambda x: x.created_at, reverse=True)
    
    def mark_notification_as_read(self, notification_id: str) -> bool:
        """Mark a notification as read."""
        notification = self.notifications.get(notification_id)
        if not notification:
            return False
        
        if notification.user != self.current_user:
            raise PermissionError("Cannot mark another user's notification as read")
        
        notification.is_read = True
        self._save_all_data()
        return True
    
    def check_deadlines(self) -> List[Notification]:
        """Check for upcoming and overdue deadlines and create notifications."""
        current_time = datetime.now()
        new_notifications = []
        
        for task in self.tasks.values():
            if task.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED:
                continue
            
            time_until_deadline = task.deadline - current_time
            
            # Check for overdue tasks (deadline passed)
            if time_until_deadline < timedelta(0):
                # Check if overdue notification already exists
                existing_overdue = any(
                    notif.task_id == task.task_id and 
                    notif.type == NotificationType.TASK_OVERDUE and
                    not notif.is_read
                    for notif in self.notifications.values()
                )
                
                if not existing_overdue:
                    notification_id = self._generate_id("notif")
                    notification = Notification(
                        notification_id=notification_id,
                        user=task.assigned_to,
                        type=NotificationType.TASK_OVERDUE,
                        message=f"Task '{task.title}' is overdue!",
                        task_id=task.task_id,
                        created_at=current_time
                    )
                    self.notifications[notification_id] = notification
                    new_notifications.append(notification)
            
            # Check for approaching deadlines (within 24 hours)
            elif timedelta(0) <= time_until_deadline <= timedelta(hours=24):
                # Check if approaching deadline notification already exists
                existing_approaching = any(
                    notif.task_id == task.task_id and 
                    notif.type == NotificationType.DEADLINE_APPROACHING and
                    not notif.is_read
                    for notif in self.notifications.values()
                )
                
                if not existing_approaching:
                    notification_id = self._generate_id("notif")
                    notification = Notification(
                        notification_id=notification_id,
                        user=task.assigned_to,
                        type=NotificationType.DEADLINE_APPROACHING,
                        message=f"Task '{task.title}' deadline is approaching in {int(time_until_deadline.total_seconds() / 3600)} hours",
                        task_id=task.task_id,
                        created_at=current_time
                    )
                    self.notifications[notification_id] = notification
                    new_notifications.append(notification)
        
        if new_notifications:
            self._save_all_data()
        
        return new_notifications
    
    def generate_task_completion_report(self) -> Dict:
        """Generate a report on task completion rates."""
        total_tasks = len(self.tasks)
        if total_tasks == 0:
            return {"total_tasks": 0, "completion_rate": 0.0}
        
        completed_tasks = sum(1 for task in self.tasks.values() 
                            if task.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED)

        }

"""
Office_Task_Collaborator - A collaborative task management system for office environments.
This system provides task creation, assignment, tracking, calendar integration, messaging, and reporting.
"""

import uuid

from enum import Enum
from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Tuple

# ==================== Enums and Base Classes ====================

class TaskStatus(Enum):
    """Enum representing the status of a task."""
    NOT_STARTED = "not_started"
    IN_PROGRESS = "in_progress"
    COMPLETED = "completed"


class PriorityLevel(Enum):
    """Enum representing the priority level of a task."""
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"
    CRITICAL = "critical"


@dataclass
class User:

class Message:

    id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))

    sender_id: str = ""
    content: str = ""

        self.status = new_status
        self.updated_at = datetime.now()

        self.messages.append(message)

class CalendarIntegration(ABC):

# ==================== Main System Classes ====================

class OfficeTaskCollaborator:
    """
    Main system class for Office Task Collaborator.
    Manages users, tasks, projects, and provides dashboard and reporting functionality.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        """Initialize the system with empty data stores."""
        self.users: Dict[str, User] = {}
        self.tasks: Dict[str, Task] = {}
        self.projects: Dict[str, str] = {}  # project_id -> project_name
        self.calendar_integration: Optional[CalendarIntegration] = None
        self.calendar_events: Dict[str, str] = {}  # task_id -> calendar_event_id
    
    # ==================== User Management ====================
    
    def add_user(self, name: str, email: str, team: str = "") -> User:
        """Add a new user to the system."""
        user = User(name=name, email=email, team=team)
        self.users[user.id] = user
        return user
    
    def get_user(self, user_id: str) -> Optional[User]:
        """Get a user by ID."""
        return self.users.get(user_id)
    
    # ==================== Project Management ====================
    
    def create_project(self, name: str) -> str:
        """Create a new project."""
        project_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        self.projects[project_id] = name
        return project_id
    
    # ==================== Task Management ====================
    
    def create_task(self, title: str, description: str, deadline: datetime,
                   priority: PriorityLevel, creator_id: str, 
                   project_id: str = "", assignee_id: Optional[str] = None) -> Task:
        """Create a new task."""
        task = Task(
            title=title,
            description=description,
            deadline=deadline,
            priority=priority,
            creator_id=creator_id,
            project_id=project_id,
            assignee_id=assignee_id
        )
        
        self.tasks[task.id] = task
        
        # Create calendar event if integration is set
        if self.calendar_integration:
            event_id = self.calendar_integration.create_event(task)
            self.calendar_events[task.id] = event_id
        
        return task
    
    def assign_task(self, task_id: str, assignee_id: str) -> bool:
        """Assign a task to a user."""
        task = self.tasks.get(task_id)
        if not task:
            return False
        
        task.assignee_id = assignee_id
        task.updated_at = datetime.now()
        
        # Update calendar event if it exists
        if task_id in self.calendar_events and self.calendar_integration:
            self.calendar_integration.update_event(task, self.calendar_events[task_id])
        
        return True
    
    def update_task_status(self, task_id: str, status: TaskStatus) -> bool:
        """Update the status of a task."""
        task = self.tasks.get(task_id)
        if not task:
            return False
        
        task.update_status(status)
        
        # Update calendar event if it exists
        if task_id in self.calendar_events and self.calendar_integration:
            self.calendar_integration.update_event(task, self.calendar_events[task_id])
        
        return True
    
    def add_task_message(self, task_id: str, sender_id: str, content: str) -> bool:
        """Add a message to a task's communication thread."""
        task = self.tasks.get(task_id)
        if not task:
            return False
        
        task.add_message(sender_id, content)
        return True
    
    # ==================== Calendar Integration ====================
    
    def set_calendar_integration(self, integration: CalendarIntegration) -> None:
        """Set the calendar integration to use."""
        self.calendar_integration = integration
    
    # ==================== Dashboard Functions ====================
    
    def get_user_dashboard(self, user_id: str) -> Dict:
        """Get dashboard data for a specific user."""
        user_tasks = [task for task in self.tasks.values() if task.assignee_id == user_id]
        
        now = datetime.now()
        upcoming_deadlines = [
            task for task in user_tasks 
            if task.deadline > now and task.status != TaskStatus.COMPLETED
        ]
        upcoming_deadlines.sort(key=lambda x: x.deadline)
        
        completed_tasks = [task for task in user_tasks if task.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED]
        
        return {
            "user_id": user_id,
            "total_tasks": len(user_tasks),
            "not_started": len([t for t in user_tasks if t.status == TaskStatus.NOT_STARTED]),
            "in_progress": len([t for t in user_tasks if t.status == TaskStatus.IN_PROGRESS]),
            "completed": len(completed_tasks),
            "upcoming_deadlines": upcoming_deadlines[:5],  # Top 5 upcoming
            "recently_completed": completed_tasks[-5:],  # Last 5 completed
            "high_priority_tasks": [t for t in user_tasks 
                                   if t.priority in [PriorityLevel.HIGH, PriorityLevel.CRITICAL] 
                                   and t.status != TaskStatus.COMPLETED]
        }
    
    # ==================== Reporting Functions ====================
    
    def generate_task_completion_report(self, project_id: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict:
        """Generate a report on task completion rates."""
        if project_id:
            project_tasks = [t for t in self.tasks.values() if t.project_id == project_id]
        else:
            project_tasks = list(self.tasks.values())
        
        if not project_tasks:
            return {"error": "No tasks found"}
        
        total_tasks = len(project_tasks)
        completed_tasks = len([t for t in project_tasks if t.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED])
        completion_rate = (completed_tasks / total_tasks * 100) if total_tasks > 0 else 0
        
        # Calculate overdue tasks
        now = datetime.now()
        overdue_tasks = len([t for t in project_tasks 
                           if t.deadline < now and t.status != TaskStatus.COMPLETED])
        
        return {
            "total_tasks": total_tasks,
            "completed_tasks": completed_tasks,
            "completion_rate": f"{completion_rate:.1f}%",
            "overdue_tasks": overdue_tasks,
            "not_started": len([t for t in project_tasks if t.status == TaskStatus.NOT_STARTED]),
            "in_progress": len([t for t in project_tasks if t.status == TaskStatus.IN_PROGRESS]),
            "by_priority": {
                priority.value: len([t for t in project_tasks if t.priority == priority])
                for priority in PriorityLevel
            }
        }
    
    def generate_team_performance_report(self, team: str) -> Dict:
        """Generate a performance report for a specific team."""
        team_users = [u for u in self.users.values() if u.team == team]
        team_user_ids = [u.id for u in team_users]
        
        team_tasks = [t for t in self.tasks.values() if t.assignee_id in team_user_ids]
        
        if not team_tasks:
            return {"error": "No tasks found for team"}
        
        # Calculate individual performance
        user_performance = {}
        for user in team_users:
            user_tasks = [t for t in team_tasks if t.assignee_id == user.id]
            if user_tasks:
                completed = len([t for t in user_tasks if t.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED])
                total = len(user_tasks)
                user_performance[user.name] = {
                    "total_tasks": total,
                    "completed": completed,
                    "completion_rate": f"{(completed/total*100):.1f}%" if total > 0 else "0%"
                }
        
        # Calculate team averages
        total_completed = len([t for t in team_tasks if t.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED])
        completion_rate = (total_completed / len(team_tasks) * 100) if team_tasks else 0
        
        return {
            "team": team,
            "team_members": len(team_users),
            "total_tasks": len(team_tasks),
            "completion_rate": f"{completion_rate:.1f}%",
            "user_performance": user_performance,
            "tasks_by_status": {
                status.value: len([t for t in team_tasks if t.status == status])
                for status in TaskStatus
            }
        }
    
    def generate_project_progress_report(self, project_id: str) -> Dict:
        """Generate a progress report for a specific project."""
        project_tasks = [t for t in self.tasks.values() if t.project_id == project_id]
        
        if not project_tasks:

        project_name = self.projects.get(project_id, "Unknown Project")

            for t in project_tasks

        ]

        # Find blocked tasks (not started but past deadline)

            "total_tasks": total_tasks,
            "completed_tasks": completed_tasks,

                "by_priority": {

                },
                "by_status": {
                    status.value: len([t for t in project_tasks if t.status == status])

                }

"""
Office Task Collaboration Manager

A comprehensive task management system for office environments that enables
collaborative task assignment, tracking, and reporting with real-time notifications
and role-based access control.
"""

import uuid
import json
import datetime
import threading
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Set, Tuple
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict

class TaskStatus(Enum):

class TaskPriority(Enum):

class UserRole(Enum):

@dataclass
class User:

    user_id: str
    username: str
    email: str
    password_hash: str
    role: UserRole
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
    
    def verify_password(self, password: str) -> bool:
        """Verify if the provided password matches the stored hash."""
        return self.password_hash == hashlib.sha256(password.encode()).hexdigest()
    
    def has_permission(self, required_role: UserRole) -> bool:
        """Check if user has required role or higher."""
        role_hierarchy = {
            UserRole.ADMIN: 5,
            UserRole.MANAGER: 4,
            UserRole.TEAM_LEAD: 3,
            UserRole.MEMBER: 2,
            UserRole.VIEWER: 1
        }
        return role_hierarchy[self.role] >= role_hierarchy[required_role]


@dataclass
class Comment:

    def update_status(self, new_status: TaskStatus):
        """Update task status and record update time."""
        self.status = new_status
        self.last_updated = datetime.now()
    
    def is_overdue(self) -> bool:
        """Check if task is past its deadline."""
        if not self.deadline:
            return False
        return datetime.now() > self.deadline and self.status != TaskStatus.COMPLETED
    
    def is_deadline_approaching(self, hours_threshold: int = 24) -> bool:
        """Check if deadline is approaching within specified hours."""
        if not self.deadline or self.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED:
            return False
        time_until_deadline = self.deadline - datetime.now()
        return timedelta(hours=0) < time_until_deadline <= timedelta(hours=hours_threshold)

# ============================================================================
